name: Tip142 NPN Darlington Bipolar Power Transistor 100V 10A TO-247
desc: The TIP142 is an STMicroelectronics NPN Darlington transistor rated at 100V and 10A, offering high gain and an integrated diode in a TO-247 power package.

blocks.text: Tip142 NPN Darlington Bipolar Power Transistor 100V 10A TO-247

The TIP142 belongs to a complementary family of bipolar Darlington devices documented by STMicroelectronics. It is the NPN member of the family, while the TIP147 is the corresponding PNP device. The TIP142 is a discrete semiconductor component organized around base, collector, and emitter connections. Its designation is also used as the marking on the component, clearly identifying the device within the manufacturer’s product range.

STMicroelectronics describes its construction as planar technology with a “base island” layout. The internal arrangement is monolithic, meaning the Darlington structure is formed inside one semiconductor component rather than connected from two separately packaged transistors. A Darlington arrangement combines two transistor stages into one functional unit. This internal organization distinguishes the TIP142 from a conventional single-transistor arrangement and establishes the relationship between the input connection and the collector-emitter current path.
Planar semiconductor technology with base-island layout.
Complementary design with the TIP147 PNP transistor.

name: AUTOOL AS503 Engine Oil Quality Tester

blocks.text: AUTOOL AS503 Engine Oil Quality Tester

The AUTOOL AS503 is a handheld engine oil quality tester that relies on an optical detection probe to analyze the particulate content in oil. The probe is integrated with a high-precision opto-electronic sensor to ensure more accurate measurement results, and it is connected through an 800mm long flexible hose made of PTFE material, highly resistant to oil and oxidation with exceptional corrosion resistance, effectively extending the product’s lifespan.

During testing, the probe tip is submerged in the engine oil and the instrument displays the transmittance of the oil together with the current oil measurement temperature, measured by an integrated temperature sensor for convenient assessment of the engine’s operating status. The backlit 2.8-inch LCD screen provides a clear display for efficient operation in varying lighting conditions, whether bright daylight or dim nighttime.

The AS503 is compatible with the majority of gasoline and diesel engine lubricant oils available in the market. Separate sampling and measurement for gasoline and diesel engines allow for a more precise assessment of lubricant oil health. Users can select petrol (gasoline) engine mode or diesel engine mode and toggle the temperature unit between °C and °F.

The display shows the battery level, backlight indicator, sound indicator, an analog bar graph (0%-100%), the transmittance percentage, and transmittance status indications: OK (transmittance is good), a warning symbol (transmittance warning), and an X symbol (suggested to replace), related to transmittance values above 60%, between 60% and 30%, and below 30%.

The handheld portion of the body is lined with silicone substrate, providing excellent grip and a lightweight design for easy single-handed operation. The tester is powered by 4 x 1.5V AAA batteries (6V), switches off automatically after 5 minutes of no activity, and can be powered on or off with a long press of approximately 2 seconds.

blocks.text: TOF VL53L0/1XV2 Time-of-Flight Laser Ranging Sensor

The TOF VL53L0/VL53L1XV2 Time-of-Flight Laser Ranging Sensor is a compact distance-measuring module designed for accurate, non-contact object detection. It uses an infrared laser emitter and a receiver to calculate distance by measuring the time taken for emitted light to reflect off an object and return to the sensor. Unlike conventional infrared sensors that estimate distance based on reflected light intensity, ToF technology measures the light’s travel time, making it suitable for a wide range of electronic sensing applications.

The module communicates with microcontrollers and development boards through the I²C interface, allowing it to integrate with Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, and other compatible systems. The VL53L0X can measure distances up to approximately 2 meters, while the VL53L1X can reach up to approximately 4 meters under suitable conditions. Its compact design, low power consumption, and digital output make it useful for robotics, smart devices, automated systems, and embedded projects. Actual measurement performance depends on the sensor version, target reflectivity, ambient light, and operating conditions.

The LMH6503MA from National Semiconductor is a wideband, DC-coupled, differential-input linear variable gain amplifier (VGA) consisting of a voltage-controlled gain stage followed by a high-speed current feedback op amp that can directly drive low-impedance loads.

The device provides a gain adjustment range of more than 70dB for frequencies up to 10MHz (79dB typical). blocks.text: TOP222P Three-terminal Off-line PWM Switch 9V 100mA DIP-8

The TOP222P is part of the TOPSwitch-II family of three-terminal off-line PWM switches. It integrates a high-voltage power MOSFET, PWM controller, high-voltage startup circuit, loop compensation, current limiting, auto-restart, and thermal protection into a single IC, reducing the number of external components required for a switching power supply. The device is designed for high-efficiency power conversion and can be used in flyback, forward, boost, and buck topologies.

The TOP222P uses an 8-lead PDIP package, with multiple SOURCE pins providing the primary-side return and helping transfer heat directly into the PCB. It operates with primary-side or optocoupler feedback and supports both discontinuous and continuous conduction modes. The internal oscillator operates at a nominal 100 kHz, while cycle-by-cycle current limiting, auto-restart, and thermal shutdown provide protection during overload and fault conditions.

name: UNI-T UT336E Digital Manifold Gauge
desc: UNI-T UT336E Digital Manifold Gauge: 162+ refrigerants, 4 test modes, superheat/subcooling calc, wireless app & IP54 for HVAC pros.

blocks.text: The UNI-T UT336E Digital Manifold Gauge (also called AC Diagnoser) facilitates the installation, debugging and maintenance of refrigeration and heat pump systems. It accurately measures high- and low-side pressures.

The device combines a 3.5-inch TFT color screen with an analog-dial style UI for clear measurement display and status indication. Evaporation and condensation (saturation) temperatures are automatically calculated from the built-in refrigerant database at the current pressures, while T1/T2 surface temperatures are measured by the wireless clamps (SH = T1 − EV; SC = CO − T2).

Four measurement modes cover the entire repair workflow: Refrigeration, Evacuation, Pressure Test and Delta T. In Pressure Test mode the device records the initial pressure and the scale turns yellow if the system leaks. In Evacuation mode it displays operation time and vacuum percentage.

With built-in parameters for 162 refrigerants (updatable via mobile app), A2L refrigerant compatibility, audible/visual alarms, temperature compensation for pressure-holding tests, and wireless remote monitoring via the iENV mobile app (real-time data viewing and report export), the UT336E is a complete diagnostic solution for HVAC/R technicians. Its IP54 housing, 2 m drop protection, metal hanging hook and rechargeable 5200 mAh lithium battery with Type-C charging make it suitable for harsh field environments.

blocks.text: Opto-isolated AC Input Detector Module 4 Channel ACD4

The Opto-Isolated AC Input Detector Module (ACD4) is a four-channel interface board designed to detect AC voltage signals while providing complete electrical isolation between the input and output circuits. Using optocoupler technology, the module converts high-voltage AC signals into low-voltage logic signals that can be safely monitored by electronic control systems. Each channel operates independently, allowing multiple AC sources to be monitored simultaneously.

The module is ideal for industrial automation, power monitoring, and smart control applications where the presence or absence of AC voltage must be detected without exposing sensitive control electronics to dangerous voltage levels. The onboard LED indicators provide a quick visual indication of the input status, while the terminal and pin header design simplifies installation and integration into existing systems.

This module supports both voltage conversion and signal isolation, allowing 3.3V or 5V microcontrollers to control devices operating at different voltage levels. The TM1990A is a CMOS electronic key device that contains a unique 64-bit digital code stored in internal nonvolatile memory. Communication with the device is performed through the 1-Wire protocol, requiring only a DATA line and a common GND connection. The device supports ROM search functionality, allowing multiple TM1990A devices to share the same 1-Wire bus.

During operation, a master controller initializes the 1-Wire bus and communicates with the TM1990A using ROM function commands. The device can provide its group code, unique 48-bit serial number, and 8-bit CRC, making it suitable for electronic identification and access-control applications.
Requires only one data connection and common ground.

It allows the driver or passenger to manually trigger the tracker’s SOS or panic function in an emergency situation, such as an accident, vehicle threat, or other situation requiring assistance. Depending on the connected GPS tracker, activating the button can initiate an SOS alert, SMS notification, phone call, or location notification to predefined contacts.

The button features a compact housing with a prominent emergency symbol and a long cable for flexible installation inside a vehicle. It can be positioned in an easily accessible location such as beneath the dashboard, near the driver, or on a vehicle control panel. The actual SOS response and activation method depend on the connected GPS tracker and its configuration.

The module is suitable for battery packs with a nominal voltage of approximately 22.2V and a fully charged voltage of 25.2V. It features a simple connection for the battery positive and negative terminals and is suitable for portable electronics, robotics, RC equipment, DIY battery packs, and other applications using 6-cell Li-Ion battery configurations.

desc: The CONTEC MS100 is a portable SpO₂ and pulse-rate simulator used to test and verify the performance, accuracy, and reaction time of pulse oximeters.

blocks.text: CONTEC MS100 SpO2 Simulator Pulse Rate Blood Oxygen Simulator Pulse Oximeter reaction time

The CONTEC MS100 SpO₂ Simulator is a small, lightweight, separated SpO₂ simulator designed for testing pulse oximeters under controlled simulated conditions. The simulator probe connects separately to the host, making testing more convenient, while built-in R-curves support compatibility with oximeters using different technologies.

The CONTEC MS100 can simulate oxygen saturation, pulse rate, preset patient states, and different signal amplitudes. It can also test the performance of a pulse oximeter under different interference sources and measure the reaction time of the tested device. Its Alarm Limits function provides dedicated tests for SpO₂ alarm, pulse-rate alarm, and asystole, with the elapsed reaction time displayed in second

The simulator supports a wide range of simulated SpO₂ values from 35% to 100% and pulse rates from 25 to 250 BPM. It can simulate different patient conditions, signal amplitudes, and interference sources, while built-in R-curves such as BCI, Masimo, and Nellcor improve compatibility with different pulse oximeter designs. The CONTEC MS100 can also test the reaction time of SpO₂, pulse rate, and cardiac-arrest detection.
As different manufacturers may use different R-curve, current popular R curves (such as BCI, Masimo, Nellcor, etc.) are embedded into the simulator in advance.

blocks.text: Super Capacitor Balancing Protection Board for 6 String 2.5V-3V

The Super Capacitor Balancing Protection Board for 6 String 2.5V–3V is designed to protect and balance six supercapacitors connected in series. It continuously monitors the voltage of each individual cell and automatically begins balancing when a cell reaches the preset threshold. This helps prevent any single capacitor from exceeding its maximum rated voltage, significantly improving the safety, reliability, and service life of the capacitor bank. Passive balancing is achieved by dissipating excess energy through power resistors when necessary.

This board is suitable for supercapacitor energy storage systems, backup power supplies, automotive applications, industrial equipment, and lithium titanate (LTO) battery packs operating in a similar voltage range. The balancing voltage can typically be adjusted within 2.5V to 3.0V per cell by modifying the resistor network, allowing the board to be adapted for different capacitor or LTO cell specifications.

desc: Manufacturer Nexperia Part Number 74HC4040D Package SO16 (SOT109-1) Datasheet 74HC4040D Description 74HC4040D is a high-speed 2V–6V CMOS 12-stage binary ripple counter with 12 parallel outputs and a master reset, housed in a 16-pin SO16 package.

blocks.text: 74HC4040D Falling Edge 12-Stage Binary Counter 2V-6V 25mA 98MHz SOIC-16 SMD IC

The 74HC4040D is a high-speed, CMOS-level 12-stage binary ripple counter featuring a clock input (CP), twelve parallel outputs (Q0 to Q11), and an overriding asynchronous master reset input (MR). The internal state of the counter advances sequentially on the HIGH-to-LOW (negative edge) transition of the clock input. Activating the master reset input with a HIGH voltage level clears all counter stages and completely forces all parallel outputs LOW, operating independently of the clock’s state. Each individual counter stage is constructed as a static toggle flip-flop. Built-in clamp diodes on the inputs allow the safe utilization of current-limiting resistors, enabling the chip to cleanly interface with signal voltages that exceed the positive supply line (VCC​).

The TDA9105 is a highly integrated deflection processor designed for multi-sync CRT monitor applications. It combines horizontal and vertical synchronization processing, dual phase-locked loops (PLLs), horizontal drive generation, vertical ramp generation, East-West correction, dynamic horizontal phase correction, and dynamic focus control within a single device. This integration significantly reduces external component count while providing accurate control of display geometry and scanning functions.

The TDA9105 device supports a wide range of horizontal and vertical synchronization frequencies, making it suitable for multisync monitor systems. Built-in safety features include X-ray protection, supply voltage monitoring, lock/unlock detection, blanking control, and output shutdown functions. The TDA9105 also provides extensive geometry adjustments such as pincushion correction, trapezoid correction, side-pin balance, parallelogram correction, vertical size, vertical position, S-correction, and dynamic focus generation for high-quality CRT image reproduction.

MC14174BCP HEX D-Type Flip Flop IC 5V 5µA DIP-16 that contains six independent D flip-flops integrated into a single DIP-16 package. All six flip-flops share a common clock input and an asynchronous active-low reset input. Data present at each D input is transferred to its corresponding Q output on the positive-going edge of the clock signal, making the device ideal for sequential logic and digital storage applications.

Built using complementary MOS technology, the MC14174BCP offers low power consumption, high noise immunity, and a wide operating voltage range. The device includes buffered inputs and outputs along with input protection circuitry for improved reliability. It is functionally equivalent to the classic 74174 TTL device while providing the advantages of CMOS operation, making it suitable for industrial, educational, embedded, and digital control systems.

blocks.text: LM3403 Quad Operational Amplifier 3V 2.8mA IC DIP-14

The LM3403 is a monolithic quad operational amplifier that integrates four independent high-gain operational amplifiers within a single package. Each amplifier is internally frequency compensated, simplifying circuit design while providing stable operation across a wide range of analog applications. The device is designed to operate from either a single supply or dual power supplies, making it suitable for both industrial and general-purpose electronic systems.

A key advantage of the LM3403 is its input common-mode range, which includes the negative supply rail, allowing direct interfacing with ground-referenced signals without requiring additional biasing circuitry. The device features a Class-AB output stage for reduced crossover distortion and short-circuit protected outputs, making it useful in active filters, oscillators, instrumentation circuits, signal conditioning systems, and voltage reference applications.

The FNIRSI® LCR-P1 Multifunction LCR Transistor Capacitor Tester is a compact electronic component analyzer created for technicians, engineers, repair specialists, and electronics enthusiasts. It provides a convenient way to examine many commonly used components without manually identifying every terminal or calculating values from separate measurements. Components are inserted into the locking test socket, and the instrument automatically analyzes the connected device before presenting the result on its color display.

The tester can identify two-terminal and three-terminal parts, determine their pin arrangement, and display relevant electrical information in an easy-to-read visual format. It is designed to work with transistors, diodes, Zener diodes, field-effect transistors, thyristors, capacitors, resistors, inductors, and low-voltage batteries. In addition to component analysis, the LCR-P1 includes an infrared decoding mode for checking compatible remote-control signals and displaying their decoded information and waveform. Its rechargeable handheld design makes it suitable for use at a workbench, in a repair area, or during portable troubleshooting. Automatic recognition reduces connection uncertainty, simplifies repeated testing, and helps users quickly evaluate unidentified, removed, or replacement electronic components before installation efficiently.

It is designed to store and transfer digital data based on clock signals, making it ideal for use in registers, data latches, and bus-oriented systems. The 3-state output feature allows the outputs to be placed in a high-impedance state, enabling multiple devices to share a common data bus without interference.

This IC operates by capturing input data on the rising edge of the clock signal and holding it until the next clock cycle. Its DIP package makes it easy to use in prototyping and through-hole PCB designs. The 74574 is widely used in digital circuits for temporary data storage, signal buffering, and interfacing between different parts of a system, especially in microprocessor and microcontroller applications.

The Universal 6.3mm Silicone Nozzle Protection Sleeve is a replaceable accessory designed for use with manual desoldering pumps. It fits over the front nozzle of the solder sucker, creating a protective layer between the original pump tip and the hot soldering area. This helps reduce direct exposure of the nozzle to heat, solder residue, and repeated contact during PCB repair and component removal.

During normal desoldering work, the front of the pump is repeatedly positioned close to the soldering iron and molten solder. Over time, this can cause wear, deformation, or deterioration of the original nozzle. The silicone sleeve acts as a sacrificial protective section, allowing the inexpensive sleeve to take most of this wear instead of the desoldering pump nozzle itself.

name: UAA1008A‑DP Tuning System Linear Processor IC DIP‑24
desc: UAA1008A‑DP PLL Tuning Processor IC DIP‑24 for analog TV/FM tuner systems.

blocks.text: UAA1008A‑DP PLL Tuning Processor IC DIP‑24

The UAA1008A‑DP is a monolithic silicon integrated circuit engineered by Motorola as the analog interface core for digital television tuning memory systems. Far more than a simple support chip, it bridges the digital control section—using companion ICs such as the MC14425, MC14429, or MC14426—and the analog front-end of a TV set. The device integrates a precise digital‑to‑analog converter for varicap tuning voltage generation, dual‑rail regulated power supplies (a high‑voltage 34V varicap rail and a low‑noise 5V VDD supply for external CMOS logic), and a bank of three high‑current band‑switch drivers capable of sourcing up to 35mA each. Station capture logic processes negative‑going video modulation, positive flyback pulses, and a video carrier discriminator AFC signal, automatically gating the tuning window and verifying station presence. The UAA1008A‑DP thus replaces discrete tuning‑interface circuitry with a single, reliable 24‑pin DIP package, making it essential for restoring classic TV chassis or studying late‑20th‑century electronic tuning architectures.
Integrated digital‑to‑analog converter generates a precise varicap tuning voltage, eliminating complex discrete DAC circuits.
On‑chip 34V regulated supply for varicap diodes and a separate 5V regulated output for external logic (up to 10mA), ensuring stable operation.
Three dedicated band‑switch output drivers (VHF I, VHF III, UHF) with 35mA continuous current capability for direct tuner control.
Automatic station capture logic uses video, flyback, and AFC signals to enable reliable search‑and‑lock without external processors.

blocks.text: TOP253YN Integrated Off-Line Switcher IC TO-220-7C

The TOP253YN is a monolithic integrated off-line switcher that incorporates a 700V power MOSFET, a high-voltage switched current source, PWM control, oscillator, and protective circuitry into a single TO-220-7C package. This high level of integration eliminates many external components, simplifying power supply design. During normal operation, the duty cycle of the internal power MOSFET decreases linearly with increasing current at the CONTROL pin, enabling precise output regulation.

The device features multi-mode operation to optimize efficiency across the entire load range. At heavy loads, it operates in full-frequency PWM mode (selectable 66 kHz or 132 kHz). As load decreases, it smoothly transitions to variable frequency mode, then low-frequency PWM, and finally multi-cycle modulation mode at light loads. This significantly reduces no-load and standby power consumption, with typical no-load input power below 200 mW at 230 VAC, aligning with EcoSmart energy-efficient standards.

desc: D8257C-5 Programmable four-channel 8-bit DMA controller for fast memory & peripheral transfers, reducing CPU workload & improving system efficiency in embedded systems.

blocks.text: D8257C-5 200ns 8-bit Programmable DMA Controller IC 5V 120mA DIP-40

The µPD8257 is a programmable four-channel direct memory access controller designed to transfer data between peripheral devices and memory without heavy CPU involvement. It is built for 8080A/8085A-based systems and can move data efficiently by taking control of the bus when a peripheral requests service. This makes it useful where fast block transfers and reduced processor overhead are important.

When a DMA request arrives, the controller generates the proper memory address sequence, selects the correct channel, and handles the data transfer timing automatically. It supports both input and output data movement, so it can read from memory to a peripheral or write from a peripheral into memory. The device also provides control signals that keep the transfer synchronized with the system.

The µPD8257 also supports DMA read, DMA write, and DMA verify operations, along with terminal count and priority handling for multiple channels. Its role is to simplify data movement in microprocessor systems by managing repetitive transfer tasks in hardware, allowing the CPU to continue other work while the controller handles the transfer cycle.

name: AN6337 VTR Playback Video Signal Processing Circuits 5V IC DIP-22
desc: AN6337 is A dedicated video signal processing IC used in VTR (Video Tape Recorder) playback systems to restore and process composite video signals.

blocks.text: AN6337 VTR Playback Video Signal Processing Circuits 5V IC DIP-22

The AN6337 is a specialized integrated circuit developed primarily for use in VTR (Video Tape Recorder) playback sections, where it handles the processing of recorded video signals. This IC integrates multiple analog signal processing stages required for playback, such as amplification, equalization, clamping, and filtering, ensuring that the reproduced video signal maintains proper amplitude, timing, and quality. It is designed to work with composite video signals extracted from magnetic tape heads.

This IC simplifies VTR circuit design by combining several discrete components into a single DIP-22 package, reducing board complexity and improving reliability. It plays a crucial role in restoring degraded signals during playback, compensating for frequency losses, and stabilizing sync levels. The AN6337 is commonly found in legacy VHS players, video decks, and analog video processing equipment.
Integrated video signal processing for VTR playback.
Internal clamping circuit for stable video levels.
Designed for composite video signal handling.
Stable and reliable analog processing performance.
Optimized for magnetic tape playback systems.

name: Intel P8275 Gain Differential Amplifier 27V 1mA 80KHz IC DIP-40
desc: Intel P8275 is a programmable CRT controller that buffers memory, generates raster timing, DMA bursts & cursor/light-pen control for microcomputer displays.

blocks.text: Intel P8275 Gain Differential Amplifier 27V 1mA 80KHz IC DIP-40

The 8275 is a single-chip programmable CRT controller designed to interface raster-scan CRT displays with Intel microcomputer systems. It buffers display information from main memory, manages row and character timing, and generates raster timing (horizontal and vertical retrace). By providing two row buffers and programmable counters, the device refreshes the screen while minimizing CPU and DMA overhead, enabling flexible character and screen formats.

The chip supports 1–80 characters per row and 1–64 rows per frame, with programmable lines per character (1–16) and underline placement. It decodes character and field attributes (blink, highlight, reverse video, underline, plus two general-purpose outputs) and provides special control codes (end-of-row, end-of-screen) to reduce memory and DMA traffic. Two 80-character row buffers and two 16-character FIFOs support visible and invisible field-attribute modes.

The 8275 generates DMA requests for burst transfers (1–8 characters per burst) with programmable burst spacing, and signals interrupts at frame boundaries. It exposes a 3-state bidirectional data bus, command/parameter/status registers, light-pen inputs and registers, and cursor control with four cursor formats. The chip requires external dot-timing/dot-clock logic and typically interfaces with standard character generator ROMs; its programmability reduces external hardware and software complexity.

desc: D8259AC-2 is an 8-input programmable interrupt controller (28-pin DIP) offering vectored interrupts, cascading, and programmable priority.

blocks.text: NEC D8259AC-2 Processor / Microcontroller IC DIP-28

The D8259AC-2 is an interrupt controller designed to manage and prioritize multiple hardware interrupt requests for microprocessor systems. It centralizes handling of asynchronous events, reducing processor overhead by managing interrupt requests, generating vectored interrupts, and supplying a prioritized response. Internally it maintains request and service registers that track pending and serviced interrupts, enabling precise control over interrupt acknowledgement and masking.

Built for straightforward integration, the device supports cascading to expand interrupt capacity, allowing a master–slave arrangement where one master can control multiple slave controllers. Its programmable interface permits initialization and mode selection through defined control words, while its internal priority resolution supports flexible schemes to match system requirements. The chip interfaces directly with CPU interrupt acknowledge cycles to supply vector information.

Physically available in a 28-pin DIP package, the UPD8259A is compatible with TTL logic levels and standard +5V operation common to legacy microprocessor platforms. Its compact form and predictable behavior make it suitable for embedded and general-purpose systems where deterministic interrupt handling is required. Its simple programming model, clear signal timing, and support for both edge and level-triggered events simplify system design and debugging across a wide range of legacy platforms.

desc: H11F3 is a high-precision Photo FET optocoupler IC in DIP-6 package, providing reliable electrical isolation and low distortion signal switching.

blocks.text: H11F3 High-Precision Photo FET Optocoupler IC DIP-6

The H11F3 High-Precision Photo FET Optocoupler IC in DIP-6 package is designed to provide reliable electrical isolation and low-distortion analog signal switching in sensitive electronic circuits. It integrates an infrared LED optically coupled to a MOSFET output, ensuring excellent linearity and minimal leakage. The device offers high isolation voltage up to5300Vrms, low ON resistance typically30Ω, and fast switching response suitable for signal frequencies up to100kHz. It operates with an input forward voltage of approximately1.2V and a recommended forward current of10mA. The compact DIP-6 package ensures easy PCB mounting and compatibility with standard through-hole designs. It is widely used in test equipment, communication systems, industrial control circuits, and audio signal routing applications where stable, noise-free isolation is required.

Each independent section is triggered by either a leading-edge (A) or trailing-edge (B) transition, providing a wide range of output pulse widths determined by external Rₑₓₜ and Cₑₓₜ components connected to pins 6, 7, 9, and 10.

Complementary outputs at Q and Q̅ provide versatile logic interfacing, while the VDD and VSS pins at 16 and 8 ensure stable biasing. Its retriggerable capability and 100ns typical propagation delay at 15VDC make it ideal for industrial control systems and precision delay applications.

The BYT16-1000 is a power diode array packaged in a TO-220AC through-hole housing, designed for robust high-voltage rectification and dual-diode switching roles in power electronics. It contains two diode elements in one single molded package, electrically arranged so each diode can handle moderate continuous current and high reverse blocking voltage. The TO-220 form factor allows direct PCB mounting and good thermal dissipation when used with heatsinks or chassis, making it suitable for dense power stages where heat management is critical.

Internally, the dual diodes provide a combination of rectifying elements that simplifies circuit layouts by consolidating what would otherwise require two discrete diodes. This approach enhances mechanical reliability and reduces board space compared with discrete diode pairs. Junctions are typically matched and thermally coupled, ensuring even current sharing and predictable performance under load. The molded plastic body with metal tab ensures durability and mechanical support in industrial and consumer power systems.

Electrically, the BYT16-1000 balances continuous high current capability with high blocking voltage — enabling it to serve in both rectifier bridges and filtering stages. The array’s construction minimizes stress on individual elements and improves transient tolerance. Its straightforward mounting and rugged package housings allow designers to integrate it into power conversion, charger, inverter, or motor drive applications where high voltage and current handling are required without bulky support circuitry.

This design allows for electrical isolation between the input and output circuits, protecting sensitive control electronics from high voltages, ground loops, and noise on the output side. It is commonly used to interface logic signals between systems operating at different voltage potentials or to provide a safety barrier in power supply and motor control circuits. With its ability to handle continuous input current and provide a clean, amplified output signal, the TIL116 serves as a robust solution for digital logic interfacing and AC mains detection.

This optocoupler is characterized by its high direct-current transfer ratio, ensuring efficient signal transmission with minimal input drive. The device’s construction ensures stable performance across a wide range of humidity and temperature conditions, while its high-voltage electrical isolation makes it suitable for industrial and consumer applications requiring safety certification. The phototransistor output can switch loads up to 30 volts, making it compatible with TTL/CMOS logic and various microcontroller inputs. For applications needing to switch higher power loads, the TIL116 is often used to drive a separate power transistor or relay.
Optically Coupled to a Silicon N-P-N Phototransistor.

blocks.text: TIL113M Optocoupler with Transistor Output 30V 150mA DIP-6

The TIL113M is a general-purpose optocoupler that provides electrical isolation by transferring signals through light. It contains a gallium arsenide infrared LED optically coupled to a photodarlington transistor, offering significantly higher current gain compared to standard phototransistor optocouplers. When the input LED is energized, the emitted light activates the Darlington output stage, allowing signal transmission without direct electrical connection between input and output circuits.

Thanks to its high sensitivity and strong current transfer capability, the TIL113M is ideal for applications where low input current must control higher load currents. The device offers high isolation voltage and reliable performance in industrial environments, power control systems, and microcontroller interfaces. Its standard 6-pin DIP through-hole package ensures easy installation for both prototyping and production designs.

blocks.text: The 24C02N is a tiny, non-volatile serial EEPROM providing 2K-bit storage arranged as 256 × 8-bit words. It is implemented as a two-wire (I²C) memory device and is built to be compact and easy to integrate with microcontrollers. The device is optimized for low-power operation and is offered in common space-saving packages so it can be added to small boards or legacy through-hole designs.

Memory is accessed through a two-wire serial protocol with standard start/stop, acknowledge and sequential read/write procedures. The device retains the last addressed location between operations, supports page writes, and implements acknowledge-polling to signal internal write completion. A hardware write-protect pin provides a simple way to prevent unwanted memory writes. The interface is designed to be interoperable with typical microcontroller I²C peripherals.

The 24C02N is available in several package styles including an 8-lead DIP suitable for through-hole mounting, making it convenient for prototyping and repairable designs. Its small footprint, nonvolatile data retention, and simple serial interface make it suitable as a configuration, calibration or user-settings store on a wide range of electronic products. desc: 4N33 optocoupler: photodarlington isolator with IR LED, high gain output, DIP-6 package — provides electrical isolation for safe, compact signal switching.

blocks.text: 4N33 Optocoupler Photodarlington Output High Gain DIP-6

The 4N33 is an optically coupled isolator that pairs a gallium arsenide infrared LED with a silicon photodarlington sensor. It converts light from the input LED into a proportional electrical response at the photodarlington, allowing a drive circuit to control a separated load circuit without direct electrical connection. This optical link preserves signal integrity while preventing ground loops and reducing interference between sections of a system.

Inside the device, the photodarlington stage amplifies the photocurrent generated by the LED, producing an output current and voltage sufficient to drive subsequent circuitry. The intrinsic high-gain behavior of the photodarlington makes the part easy to interface, minimizing the need for extra amplification stages in many designs. Signal transitions are handled with predictable propagation characteristics so it can be used where controlled switching is required.

Encapsulated in a compact, standard plastic DIP-6 package, the 4N33 supports conventional through-hole assembly and straightforward PCB layout. The physical separation between LED and detector, along with insulating materials, provides electrical isolation that helps protect sensitive electronics and users from unwanted voltages. Overall, the 4N33 offers a simple, robust way to achieve electrical isolation with an optically mediated switching element and reliable operation.

name: HD14530BP CMOS Integrated Circuit IC DIP-16
desc: The HD14530BP is a CMOS-family integrated circuit in a 16-pin DIP package used in digital electronics.

blocks.text: HD14530BP CMOS Integrated Circuit IC DIP-16

The HD14530BP is a dual five-input majority logic gate implemented in CMOS. Each gate evaluates five logic inputs (A–E) plus a control/test input W; the output Z is driven high when three or more inputs are logical “1.” The device’s monolithic CMOS structure uses P- and N-channel enhancement transistors and includes diode protection on every input. It accepts a wide supply range and can directly drive standard TTL loads.

Functionally the HD14530BP simplifies many combinational and sequential circuits by providing majority-logic primitives (5-input and 3-input majority behavior) that can be reconfigured by tying inputs or using W as a control to realize OR, AND, NAND, NOR, XNOR and related functions with fewer external parts. The device incorporates static-protection circuitry to reduce ESD risk; the datasheet notes unused inputs must be tied to VSS or VDD.

The datasheet covers plastic DIP-16, ceramic DIP and SOIC packages with full pin assignments (VDD = pin 16, VSS = pin 8) and outline drawings. Electrical data include input thresholds, VOH/VOL, drive currents, quiescent and dynamic supply currents, input capacitance, and timing (propagation delays and rise/fall times) at VDD = 5, 10 and 15 V. Example circuits shown include flip-flops and astable multivibrators.
Wide operating supply range: 3.0 V to 18 V.

The XLR Cable Connector 3 Pin for Wire with a blue ring is a standardized audio interface connector used to terminate cables in balanced audio systems. Its robust three-pin metal housing supports balanced signal transmission, meaning the audio signal travels over paired conductors with a dedicated ground, helping reduce noise and interference over long cable runs. This type of cable connector is widely recognized as the professional standard for connecting microphones, mixers, amplifiers, and other pro audio equipment.

The blue ring around the connector can serve as a visual identifier or coding marker to distinguish different channels, inputs, or segments in a larger setup. The connector’s round metal shell features a latch-type mechanism that securely locks into place when mated with a corresponding XLR port, preventing accidental disconnection even under motion or tension. Internally, the three pins are arranged to carry ground, positive, and negative (hot/cold) balanced signals, contributing to clear and noise-free audio.

Constructed from durable materials such as zinc die-cast shell and high-quality plated contacts, the blue-ring XLR connector is designed to withstand repeated plugging cycles and the physical demands of live sound or studio environments. Its ergonomic design and strain-relief features make it relatively easy to assemble onto cable ends and maintain over time. Whether used in live performance, recording studios, or professional AV installations, this connector plays a critical role in secure, high-integrity audio connections.

name: 5L0365R Power Switch IC DIP-8
desc: 5L0365R Integrated Fairchild Power Switch (DIP-8) combining high-voltage SenseFET & PWM controller for compact offline SMPS minimizes parts & eases design.

blocks.text: The 5L0365R in the KA5x03xx family is a compact Fairchild Power Switch (FPS) IC integrating a high-voltage SenseFET with a current-mode PWM controller in an 8-pin DIP package. Designed for offline switched-mode power supplies, it reduces component count by combining the MOSFET and control circuitry into a single chip, simplifying design and saving board space for compact consumer products.

The architecture emphasizes clean linearity and stable operation across the commercial temperature range, enabling predictable analog performance in mixed-signal systems.

Internally the amplifiers use matched JFET input transistors and precision biasing to reduce offset and drift while preserving wide dynamic range. The device’s noise characteristics and extremely high input resistance are optimized for high-impedance signal chains.

Practical in single- or dual-supply environments, the LF442CN supports generous output swing and includes output short-circuit protection to guard outputs. External offset nulling is available on related family members, and the device is specified with conservative limits so designers can predict worst-case behavior when optimizing low-power analog front ends. name: 74533 High Speed CMOS Logic Octal Inverting Latches with 3-State Outputs 5V 8µA IC PDIP-20
desc: 74533 Octal inverting transparent latch used to temporarily hold and buffer 8-bit data lines and drive bus-level three-state outputs for microprocessor.

blocks.text: 74533 High Speed CMOS Logic Octal Inverting Transparent Latches with 3-State Outputs 5V 8µA IC PDIP-20

The 74533 is a high-speed CMOS octal inverting transparent latch with common latch-enable (LE) and common three-state output-enable (OE) controls. While LE is asserted the eight inputs (D0–D7) pass through to the outputs. OE places all outputs into high-impedance when asserted, allowing easy bus sharing and hot-swapping of devices on a common data bus. The device is manufactured in HC/HCT silicon-gate CMOS technology to provide low static power consumption and TTL/LSTTL compatibility in the HCT variant.

Designed as a rugged bus-interface component, the 74533 features buffered inputs and three-state outputs capable of driving multiple LSTTL loads, balanced transition times, and operation over a wide temperature range. It’s available in multiple package options (PDIP, SOIC, CERDIP) for through-hole and surface-mount assembly, and its independent LE/OE controls make it convenient for gating, register staging, and temporary data storage in microprocessor systems, address/data multiplexing, and glue-logic applications.

The component is constructed on a ceramic core with a deposited carbon film that establishes its 75-ohm resistance value, then coated with epoxy for insulation and mechanical protection.

Temperature coefficient and tolerance follow the CR series specifications (tolerances ±5% standard, ±2% option), and the part is tested for load-life, humidity and pulse overload performance according to the CR series test methods (JIS C 5202). It shows predictable drift characteristics within the specified limits after stress tests.

Because of its compact size (bulk dimensions for the 1/2 W CR type) and robust epoxy coating, this 75 Ω 0.5 W resistor is useful where a reliable, low-cost passive resistor is required. It is solderable per the supplier’s solderability and solder-heat recommendations and offers long service life (use life ≥10,000 hours under rated conditions).

name: UNI-T UT204A Digital Clamp Meter
desc: UNI-T UT204A 4000-count digital clamp meter AC/DC up to 600 A, voltage to 600 V, capacitance/frequency/temperature, 28 mm clamp, REL & data-hold.

blocks.text: The UNI-T UT204A is a 4000-count AC/DC digital clamp meter engineered for electricians and field technicians who need a compact, durable instrument with broad functionality. Built around integrated circuits and a dual A/D converter, the UT204A emphasizes safety and reliability with overload protection on all ranges and a rugged construction that passes a 1-m shock test. The meter’s clamp head converts current to a measurable voltage and is designed so a single conductor passes centrally for correct readings.

Functionally, the UT204A measures AC/DC voltage and current (including high-current conductors up to 600 A), resistance, diode, continuity, capacitance, frequency and temperature via a K-type probe. It includes auto-range behavior, relative (REL) zeroing, data-hold and auto power-off, plus buzzer and visual indicators for common test modes. Its sampling rate is ~3 samples/s and it warns users of low battery and overload conditions.

Designed for indoor use and work on residential/commercial power wiring, the UT204A features a maximum clamp opening of 28 mm (max conductor Ø26 mm), automatic polarity display, and safety ratings consistent with IEC/GB standards (double insulation, CAT II 600V & CAT III 300V where noted). Practical accessories supplied include test probes and a point-contact temperature probe, making the meter useful in HVAC, maintenance and on-site troubleshooting.

blocks.text: UNI-T UT17B MAX True RMS Digital Multimeter

The UNI-T UT17B MAX True RMS Digital Multimeter is a compact, rugged instrument designed for engineers and technicians who need accurate measurements in demanding environments. Part of the UT15B/17B/18B MAX series, it combines a user-friendly layout with robust input protection and high anti-interference performance. Gold-plated standard and fine-tipped probes are included to ensure reliable contact and long-term durability during fieldwork and laboratory use.

Measurements cover DC and AC voltage up to 1000V, DC and AC current ranges including a 10A input, resistance, capacitance, frequency up to 10MHz, duty cycle and temperature via K-type thermocouple. The instrument uses a 6000-count display, offers True RMS readings for accurate AC measurement, and provides data hold, MAX/MIN capture and relative mode for comparative work.

The SAB8287A is an 8-bit bipolar bus transceiver that provides bidirectional data transfer and bus buffering with three-state outputs and dedicated control inputs for direction and output enable. It is the inverting member of the SAB8286/SAB8287 family, so inputs on the A-side are presented inverted on the B-side (useful where logic inversion is required between subsystems). Direction is controlled by the T (TRANSMIT) input and outputs are gated by the active-LOW OE (OUTPUT ENABLE) control, allowing easy interfacing to microprocessor and system buses.

Designed for 5 V systems, the device offers robust output drive for system-level loads and supports a high-impedance (three-state) mode to allow multiple devices to share the bus without output low-glitches when entering/leaving the high-Z state. It was commonly used as a data bus buffer/driver in systems based on SAB8086/SAB80286 families and other microcomputer architectures that require reliable, bidirectional 8-bit bus interfacing.

name: PD4164-3 DRAM 65,536 x 1 Bit Memory IC DIP-16
desc: PD4164-3 64K×1 dynamic N-channel MOS DRAM, single +5V operation, 16-pin DIP, 150ns access, CAS-controlled three-state output with hidden refresh.

blocks.text: PD4164-3 DRAM 64K x 1 Bit Memory IC DIP-16

The PD4164-3 is a 65,536-word by 1-bit dynamic N-channel MOS DRAM designed for single +5V operation. It employs a double-poly silicon-gate process and a single-transistor storage cell, maximizing storage density while minimizing power through integrated 512 sense amplifiers and advanced dynamic circuitry. The device internally generates negative substrate bias, making biasing automatic and transparent to the user.

Its architecture uses multiplexed address inputs enabling a compact 16-pin DIP package that yields high system bit density and automated handling compatibility. The three-state, non-latched TTL-compatible output is CAS-controlled independently of RAS; holding CAS low preserves output data while RAS performs refresh cycles. A hidden-refresh capability allows CAS to remain low during RAS-only refresh operations.

Refresh management covers 128 refresh cycles using A0–A6 within each 2 ms period, and supports normal read/write, read-modify-write, RAS-only refresh and page-mode operation. Designed with low power in mind, it balances refresh timing and circuitry to maximize yield and compatibility across DRAM generations, making it suitable for legacy systems requiring compact, single-bit memory elements. Its design prioritizes manufacturing yield and long-term reliability through conservative refresh characteristics and minimized power dissipation, simplifying integration into memory subsystems and easing maintenance in fielded equipment.

Read, write, read-write, read-modify-write, RAS-only refresh, and page-mode capability.

blocks.text: PT2221-001 Infrared Remote Control Transmitter IC SMD

The PT2221-001 is a compact CMOS infrared remote-control encoder packaged in a 20-pin SO footprint, engineered for handheld consumer remote transmitters. It integrates a key-scan matrix and internal timing/encoding logic so multiple keypad inputs can be converted into serial IR code with minimal external circuitry. The small footprint and low standby current make it ideal for battery-powered handsets.

Internally the PT2221 scans key inputs, encodes function/customer codes and provides the serial data stream suitable for IR LED drivers and transmitter front-ends. A dedicated SEL input enables extended code sets, allowing designers to double the available function codes without changing the basic hardware. The device is pin-to-pin compatible with common NEC encoder parts, easing redesign or replacement.

The datasheet includes simple application circuits (oscillator/resonator, LED driver resistor and key-matrix wiring) so engineers can move from prototype to production quickly. With a recommended supply range that supports single-cell battery operation and low quiescent consumption, the PT2221-001 is a practical choice for TVs, audio equipment, set-top boxes and other consumer electronics requiring a reliable, low-cost IR encoder.

Engineered for longevity and consistent performance, the ME-8104 combines a robust mechanical life with protective sealing that resists dust and splashing water. The roller arm’s geometry and return spring ensure repeatable actuation even in high-cycle environments. As a result, this switch serves as a reliable electromechanical sensor that bridges the mechanical motion of a machine to electronic control responses, making it a staple in industrial automation and safety stop systems.

name: ISO203 LASER Receiver 900nm
desc: ISO203 LASER Receiver 900 nm detects near-infrared laser beams, providing a logic output for microcontroller interfacing in simple laser detection systems.

blocks.text: The ISO203 LASER Receiver 900 nm is a compact optical receiver module designed to detect laser light specifically around the 900 nm wavelength range. It functions as a sensitive photodetector that responds when a laser beam is aligned with its receiving surface. The device is often used in simple emitter–receiver setups where a matching infrared laser (around 900 nm) is positioned to shine directly toward the receiver. When the laser beam is uninterrupted and strikes the ISO203 sensor, the module outputs a detectable electrical signal that can be read by a microcontroller or other electronic interface.

Unlike broad-spectrum light sensors like LDRs (light-dependent resistors), the ISO203 “laser receiver” is far more sensitive to a focused optical signal in the near-infrared range and is intended for use with direct laser beams rather than ambient light. It operates at low voltage (commonly 5 V) and provides a digital or logic-level output that changes state when the laser is detected. In many DIY and educational projects, this module is paired with simple microcontrollers (Arduino or ESP32) to build laser tripwires, security alarms, or beam-interruption systems.

ISO203 laser receiver modules are very affordable and often sold on small PCBs with three pins: power, ground, and output. They are deployed in indoor environments where external light interference is limited. While not as precise or calibrated as industrial photodiodes or scientific sensors, their simplicity and ease of integration make them popular for hobby robotics, basic optical communication projects, and light-based detection circuits.

name: LM1893N Carrier-Current Transceiver RH IC DIP-18
desc: LM1893N is a half-duplex carrier-current transceiver IC that FSK-modulates a 50–300 kHz carrier onto AC power lines and PLL-demodulates received data.

blocks.text: LM1893N Carrier-Current Transceiver RH IC DIP-18

The LM1893N is a bipolar carrier-current transceiver IC that uses building AC power mains as the communications medium for half-duplex serial data links. It implements a current-controlled oscillator whose output is shaped to a low-RFI sinusoid, and the chip provides the on-chip drive needed to couple an FSK carrier onto a power-line coupling transformer and through a coupling capacitor to the AC wiring.

In transmit mode the device FSK-modulates a 50–300 kHz carrier under control of baseband data; an internal automatic-level-control plus a robust output amplifier produce a controlled current into the tank/coupling network so the line sees a sinusoidal carrier with limited distortion. In receive mode the input from the coupling transformer passes a band-limited, Norton-style limiter and a PLL demodulator; an impulse-noise integrator and offset-cancel loop recover clean digital edges for the host controller.

The LM1893N is intended as the interface between digital controllers (microcontrollers/COPSTM) and the power line, enabling modest-rate serial links (hundreds to a few thousand baud) with strong impulse-noise immunity. The device is designed so external discrete components (transformer, coupling cap, loop-filter, impulse filter) let designers trade sensitivity, data rate, and noise rejection for their application.

It integrates the analog front-end required to support POTS on short and medium loops, combining linear ringing amplification, DC loop feed and supervision, and hybrid/impedance synthesis into a single device. The chip is designed for systems that need high ringing amplitude (operation up to 100V) so subscriber loop lengths and ring audibility can be extended without large external circuitry.

Internally the HC55185 family centralizes functions normally spread across many discretes: programmable loop current limits, ring-trip detection and filtering, battery switching (high/low), uncommitted switch for relays or test loads, and on-chip ring generation (balanced or unbalanced). The device emphasizes low standby power, reduced idle channel noise and robust off-hook detection behavior, making it suitable for remote subscriber units and access platforms where power and board space are constrained.

In practice the HC55185GCM simplifies carrier and access designs by minimizing external parts (only a few programming resistors and decoupling caps), offering integrated test/loopback modes and safety/thermal alarms. It targets VoIP and broadband voice gateways where compact, low-power, high-voltage SLIC functionality and simplified BOM are priorities. The ATmega8535-16JI is an 8-bit AVR® microcontroller that combines a compact Harvard-style RISC core with on-chip nonvolatile memory and a rich peripheral set. Optimized for low power and efficient code density, it executes most instructions in a single clock cycle and achieves up to ~16 MIPS at a 16 MHz clock. The device integrates 8 KB of in-system programmable Flash, 512 bytes of EEPROM and 512 bytes of SRAM, making it suitable for embedded code and small data storage without external memory.

Hardware peripherals are comprehensive: multiple timers (two 8-bit, one 16-bit), four PWM channels, an 8-channel 10-bit ADC (with additional differential/gain options in some packages), USART, SPI and TWI (I²C) interfaces, watchdog timer, and analog comparator. The chip provides 32 programmable I/O lines and flexible sleep modes for power management (Idle, ADC Noise Reduction, Power-save, Power-down, Standby, Extended Standby). These on-chip resources let designers build responsive, low-power control systems with minimal external components.

Physically available in several packages (including 44-lead PLCC as the -16JI part), the ATmega8535 supports In-System Programming via SPI and an optional boot section for field updates. Built with Atmel’s high-density nonvolatile memory process and backed by a broad toolchain (compilers, debuggers, evaluation kits), it’s a straightforward drop-in for projects needing a capable 8-bit MCU with reliable I/O and analog capabilities.

name: MC3403 Quad Low-Power Operational Amplifier IC DIP-14
desc: MC3403 A low-cost, quad operational amplifier IC in a DIP-14 package. It operates from a single 3V-36V supply, features four internally-compensated amps.

blocks.text: MC3403 Quad Low-Power Operational Amplifier IC DIP-14

The MC3403 is a monolithic integrated circuit that incorporates four independent, general-purpose operational amplifiers on a single silicon chip. It is engineered as a cost-effective solution for systems requiring multiple amplification stages, consolidating functionality to save board space and reduce component count. Its design emphasizes versatility and reliability for a broad range of analog circuit tasks, from basic amplification to signal conditioning and active filtering, making it a staple in both educational and industrial electronic design.

A primary design achievement of the MC3403 is its ability to operate seamlessly from a single-ended power supply, as low as 3.0 volts, or from traditional split (positive and negative) supplies. This flexibility is enabled by an input stage whose common-mode voltage range extends to the negative supply rail (ground in single-supply configurations). Consequently, the output can also swing close to the ground potential, eliminating the need for external biasing networks and simplifying circuit design in battery-powered or ground-referenced systems.

Internally, each amplifier is fully compensated for stable unity-gain operation, simplifying implementation without external capacitors. The output stage utilizes a Class AB configuration, which minimizes the crossover distortion typical of many early single-supply op-amps. Furthermore, the device includes integrated protection features such as output short-circuit protection and ESD diodes, enhancing its durability in real-world applications where faults or handling incidents may occur.
Class AB Output Stage for Minimal Crossover Distortion.

The device is intended for designers who need a robust discrete IGBT that balances blocking voltage with high current capability while remaining compact.

Built using Trench-Stop technology, the YGW60N65F1 emphasizes low conduction losses (low VCE(sat)) and stable switching behavior across temperature. It exhibits a positive temperature coefficient in saturation voltage, simplifying safe paralleling of devices. The part also provides enhanced avalanche capability and specified dynamic parameters (gate charge, capacitances, switching energies) so engineers can accurately budget drive losses and thermal performance in real systems.

Switching characteristics are optimized for inductive loads and mid-to-high frequency converters: the device shows short turn-on/turn-off delays and defined switching energies, while its integrated body diode delivers fast, soft recovery for commutation tolerance. Rated for wide junction temperatures (up to 175 °C), the YGW60N65F1 is suited to UPS, inverter, welding converter and PFC designs where reliability and thermal robustness are required.

The MN4164P-12A is a single-chip dynamic RAM organized as 64K × 1 bit with a 120 ns access time, provided in a 16-pin DIP package. It implements the standard multiplexed row/column address scheme (RAS/CAS) used by early 64K DRAMs and is intended for use as general purpose byte-serial memory in small microcomputer and embedded systems designs. The device’s single-bit data path and simple control signals make it suitable where multiple devices are combined to form wider buses.

Reads and writes are controlled with the RAS/CAS timing sequence; addresses are applied as a multiplexed pair (row then column). The device requires periodic refresh of stored data (via standard RAS-only or RAS/CAS refresh cycles) and provides an active I/O pin that floats when deselected. Typical timing and control requirements align with other 4164-class DRAMs (120 ns access characteristic).

In practice the MN4164P-12A is used in small memory expansion banks or as part of multi-chip assemblies to create 8/16-bit wide modules. Its DIP-16 package makes it easy to prototype on breadboards or through-hole PCBs. SOURCE (S): · Output MOSFET source connection for high voltage power return. Primary side control circuit common and reference point.

DRAIN (D): · High voltage power MOSFET drain output. The internal start- up bias current is drawn from this pin through a switched high- voltage current source. Internal current limit sense point for drain current.

CONTROL (C): · Error amplifier and feedback current input pin for duty cycle control. Internal shunt regulator connection to provide internal bias current during normal operation. It is also used as the connection point for the supply bypass and auto restart/compensation capacitor.

MULTI-FUNCTION (M): · Input pin for OV, UV, line feed forward with DC MAX reduction, external set current limit, remote ON/OFF and synchronization. A connection to SOURCE pin disables all functions on this pin and makes TOPSwitch-FX operate in simple three terminal mode (like TOPSwitch-II).
FREQUENCY (F): · Input pin for selecting switching frequency: 132 kHz if connected to SOURCE pin and 66 kHz if connected to CONTROL pin.

name: Ring Ferrite Core 27×14×11mm
desc: Compact Ring Ferrite Core 27×14×11mm for inductors, EMI suppression, chokes, and transformers with stable magnetic performance in high-frequency circuits.

blocks.text: The Ring Ferrite Core 27×14×11mm is a compact toroidal magnetic core made from ferrite material, designed to influence and control magnetic fields in electrical and electronic circuits. Ferrite is a ceramic-like magnetic material with high electrical resistance, which makes it ideal for minimizing unwanted eddy current losses at high frequencies. The toroidal or ring shape provides a closed magnetic path that enhances magnetic coupling and reduces magnetic leakage, making this core especially effective for inductive components and noise suppression.

In practical use, this ring ferrite core serves as the backbone of various inductive elements such as chokes, filters, and transformers. When wire is wound around the core or a conductor is passed through its center, the core increases inductance and helps filter out high-frequency interference from signals or power lines. Its physical dimensions an outer diameter of approximately 27 mm, an inner diameter near 14 mm, and a height of about 11 mm make it well-suited for DIY electronics, power supplies, and communication circuits where space is limited but electromagnetic performance matters.

The material and size balance electrical performance with mechanical robustness. Ferrite cores like this are inherently stable and resilient, capable of operating across a broad temperature range without significant changes in magnetic behavior. They are widely available and inexpensive, which makes them a go-to choice for both hobbyists and professional designers working on noise reduction, signal conditioning, or transformer design.
Made from high-resistivity ferrite material for efficient magnetic performance at high frequencies.

Manufactured by OSEPP, a provider of accessible electronics for makers, educators, and hobbyists, this board centers around the Atmel ATmega328P, an 8-bit AVR RISC-based microcontroller renowned for its efficiency and widespread adoption in embedded systems. blocks.text: Prototyping IoT devices and sensor networks.

Get the Arduino software if you have not already
Unzip the zip file to somewhere like C:\ (on Windows), so you will end up with a folder like C:\arduino-0022
Connect the USB-B end of the cable into the board
Connect the other end of the cable into a USB port on your PC/Mac
If your computer prompts for drivers, point it to the “drivers\FTDI USB Drivers” subfolder of the Arduino software, e.g. “C:\arduino-0022\drivers\FTDI USB Drivers”
You should now see the LED labeled ON near the reset button light up
Open the LED blink sketch: File menu > Examples > Basics > Blink
Select the Arduino/Genuino Uno: Tools > Board > Arduino/Genuino Uno

Select the serial port: Tools > Serial Port. This is the serial port for the board’s built-in FTDI. If you do not know which one this is, you can find out by going into Device Manager > Ports (COM & LPT), and look for a “USB Serial Port (COMx)”
Upload the sketch: File > Upload to I/O Board
Wait for the “Done uploading” message in the bottom blue status bar
The LED labeled L near pin 13 should now blink slowly
Congratulations! You have successfully uploaded your first sketch to your board.
Also the main Arduino page has troubleshooting guides for the basic errors encountered : http://arduino.cc/en/guide/troubleshooting

blocks.text: The UNI-T UT206A is a handheld AC clamp multimeter built with a focus on user safety and operational clarity. Its structure features a robust casing that houses a clear LCD display, a rotary function switch, and input terminals clearly marked for correct probe connection. An ergonomic lever mechanism operates the transformer jaws, which are designed to clamp securely around a conductor. The overall form factor is compact and portable, intended for reliable use in various electrical environments.

Operation of the UT206A is centered around an intuitive rotary switch for selecting primary measurement modes. Dedicated function buttons, including SELECT, HOLD, and a dedicated button for the display backlight, provide quick access to secondary functions and modes. The interface is designed to minimize error, with clear display symbols that indicate active modes, units of measurement, and important status alerts like low battery. The REL mode (relative measurement) is a key feature for obtaining differential readings.

This meter is engineered not just to measure electrical parameters but to do so within a strict safety framework. Its design prioritizes preventing user error and equipment damage, evident in features like overload protection, continuity testing with an audible buzzer, and clear warnings against exceeding rated voltages. The process for each measurement type from voltage and current to resistance and temperature follows a deliberate, safety-oriented procedure, emphasizing correct terminal use and pre-measurement checks of the circuit state.

blocks.text: The BQ4830YMA-85 is a compact PDIP-28 module that integrates a crystal-controlled real-time clock, power-fail control and an internal lithium backup battery with 32,768 bytes of byte-addressable nonvolatile SRAM organized as 32K×8, providing combined timekeeping and data retention in a single drop-in replacement for industry-standard 32K×8 SRAMs used in legacy and embedded systems. The module presents standard address and data bus signals for direct CPU interface and offers dual-port style clock registers that update once per second without interrupting normal SRAM access.

Internal lithium battery and power-fail detect circuit to automatically protect data on VCC loss.
Pin-compatible with industry-standard 32K × 8 SRAMs, enabling simple retrofit into existing designs.

name: 27C512 EPROM 512K-Bit DIP IC (USED)
desc: The M27C512 is a 512K (64Kx8) CMOS EPROM with a 120ns speed, in a 28-pin DIP package. It offers low power consumption.

blocks.text: The 27C512 is a 512 Kbit Erasable Programmable Read-Only Memory (EPROM) integrated circuit, organized in a 65,536 x 8-bit structure. It is offered in two primary variants: an ultraviolet (UV) erasable version, which allows for multiple reprogramming cycles, and a One Time Programmable (OTP) version for permanent code storage. The device is designed to provide a reliable and flexible non-volatile memory solution for systems where fast development and code experimentation are critical.

The chip’s operation is managed through a two-line control system consisting of Chip Enable (E) and Output Enable (G). This architecture is ideal for use in larger memory arrays, as it minimizes power dissipation and prevents output bus contention. The M27C512 features a low-power CMOS standby mode, significantly reducing current consumption when the device is not selected. For programming, it utilizes a specialized algorithm and requires a specific programming voltage to write data into the memory cells.

The device is available in several packages, including the PDIP28 (Plastic Dual In-line Package) which is a through-hole design. The UV-erasable version comes in a ceramic package (FDIP28W) with a transparent window. Exposing this window to short-wave ultraviolet light erases the entire memory content, resetting all bits to a logical ‘1’ state and preparing the device for a new program cycle, a key feature for development and debugging.

blocks.v: Bidirectional Data Bus · Input/Output · This 3-state 8-bit bidirectional data bus is used in reading status registers and writing command words through the RD/WR signal from the CPU, and also in reading the CALL instruction code by the INTA signal from the CPU.

Chip Select Input · Input · Data transfer with the CPU is enabled by RD/WR when this pin is at low level. The data bus (D0 through D7) is switched to high impedance when this pin is at high level. Note that CS does not affect INTA.

Read Input · Input · Data is transferred from the MSM82C59A-2 to the CPU when this pin is at low level. IRR (Interrupt Request Register), ISR (In-Service Register), IMR (Interrupt Mask Register), or a Poll word is selected by OCW3 and A0.
Write Input · Input · Commands are transferred from the CPU to the MSM82C59A-2 when this pin is at low level.

Address Input · Input · This pin is used together with the CS, WR, and RD signals to write commands in the command registers, and to select and read status registers. This is normally connected to the least significant bit of the address bus (A0 for MSM80C85A, A1 for MSM80C86A-10/88A-10).
Cascade Address · Input/Output · These pins are outputs when the MSM82C59A-2 is used as the master, and inputs when used as a slave (in cascade mode). These pins are outputs when in single mode.

Slave Program Input / Enable Buffer Output · Input/Output · This dual-function pin is used as an output to enable the data bus buffer in Buffered mode, and as an input for deciding whether the MSM82C59A-2 is to be master (SP/EN = 1) or slave (SP/EN = 0) during Non-buffered mode.
Interrupt Output · Output · When an interrupt request is made to the MSM82C59A-2, the INT output is switched to high level, and an INT interrupt is sent to the CPU.

Interrupt Acknowledge Input · Input · When this pin is at low level, the CALL instruction code or the interrupt vector data is enabled onto the data bus. When the CPU acknowledges the INT interrupt, INTA is sent to the MSM82C59A-2.

Request Input · Input · These interrupt request input pins for the MSM82C59A-2 can be set to edge trigger mode or level trigger mode (by ICW1). In edge trigger mode, interrupt requests are executed by the rising edge of the IR input and held until acknowledged by the CPU. In level trigger mode, interrupt requests are executed by high-level IR inputs and held until acknowledged by the CPU. These pins have a pull-up resistor.

name: SRM8 Serial Relay Module 8-Channel
desc: SRM8 is a compact 8-channel serial relay board using a shift-register interface (SPI) — expands microcontroller outputs with daisy-chainable relays, wide supply range (5–40V) and screw-terminal wiring.

blocks.text: SRM8 is an 8-channel relay module designed to allow expanding microcontroller I/O pins. SRM8 is based on the 8-bit shift register 74595 IC. It supports 8 output relays while using only three I/Os. SRM8 can be daisy-chained to further extend the outputs to theoretically an infinite number while still using the same three microcontroller I/O pins.

SRM8 module can be supplied from a wide range of voltages (5-40V). The input control signals are Digital Input (DI), Clock (CK), and Load (LD). Every time the shift register Clock input receives a low to high transition it accepts the data input value to bit0 and shifts the internal register data by one bit. Thus, 8 clock pulses are required to get one-byte data from the microcontroller. Finally, a latch pulse is required to load all internal shift register data to parallel outputs (Relays). This control sequence can be performed using a hardware-implemented SPI or a few lines of written code.
Wide operating voltage range: 5-40V (two selectable ranges).
Input signals (TTL): Data Input (DI), Clock (CK), and Load (LD).
Output signals (TTL): Data Output (DO), Clock (CK), and Load (LD).

The IRF1407PBF is a high-current N-channel HEXFET® power MOSFET offered in the through-hole TO-220AB package, engineered for aggressive power switching where very low on-resistance and high avalanche robustness are required. Built with an advanced stripe-planar process, it delivers extremely low RDS(on) per silicon area so designers can minimize conduction losses in high-current paths. The device’s TO-220 form factor makes it easy to mount on heatsinks or PCBs for effective thermal management.

Electrically the IRF1407PBF is specified for automotive and industrial use: a 75 V drain-to-source rating with a continuous drain current capability up to 130 A (TC = 25 °C) and pulse capability much higher, while supporting a maximum junction temperature up to 175 °C. The combination of ultra-low on-resistance, fast switching, and rugged avalanche capability makes the IRF540NPBF a highly efficient and reliable building block for power electronics. desc: Compact optical fingerprint module with on-board image processing and flash template storage; supports UART/USB, 1:1 & 1:N matching and fast sub-second capture.

blocks.text: GROW R307 Fingerprint Sensor UART/USB Embedded Module 44.1×20×23.5mm

The R307 is a compact, self-contained optical fingerprint identification module that integrates an image sensor, on-board processing and flash storage so fingerprint capture, template generation and matching are handled inside the module. On power up the module initializes its sensor and firmware (≈200 ms) and then waits for commands over its serial or USB interface; when a finger is presented the unit acquires a greyscale image and stores it in the image buffer for processing.

Enrollment and verification workflows are implemented in the module: the host commands the R307 to capture images, convert them to character files, combine files into templates and store templates in the internal fingerprint library. The module supports both 1:1 verification and 1:N search modes and performs template matching internally, returning match results and scores to the host.

Despite its small physical footprint, the R307 exposes a rich instruction set (enroll, search, upload/download image/template, configure parameters, etc.), configurable system parameters (baud, security level, packet length) and a persistent flash library for templates — making it well suited for embedded access control, attendance and biometric projects where the host can be a microcontroller or a PC.

name: 74HC241 Octal Buffer With Noninverted Three-State Outputs DIP-20
desc: The 74HC241 is a high-speed CMOS octal buffer with non-inverting 3-state outputs, used for driving and isolating bus lines in digital systems.

blocks.text: 74HC241 DIP Octal Buffer With Noninverted Three-State Outputs DIP-20

The 74HC241 is a high-speed CMOS integrated circuit functioning as an octal buffer and line driver with non-inverting three-state outputs. Fabricated using silicon-gate C²MOS technology, it combines the high-speed performance typically associated with LSTTL logic families with the very low power consumption inherent to CMOS circuitry. This device contains eight individual buffers, organized into two groups of four, allowing it to manage and drive multiple data lines simultaneously within a digital system.

A key feature of this IC is its three-state output capability. Each output can be in a standard logic high, a standard logic low, or a high-impedance (Hi-Z) state. This third state allows the output to be effectively disconnected from the bus, enabling multiple devices to share a common data line without electrical conflict. The outputs are non-inverting, meaning the logic level at the output matches the logic level present at the input when the device is enabled.

The device features complementary output enable controls; one active-low and one active-high, with each control pin governing a separate group of four buffers. This provides flexible control for bidirectional bus interfaces and other complex bus management tasks. All inputs are equipped with protection circuits against static discharge and transient voltage, enhancing the robustness and reliability of the device in real-world operating environments.
