blocks.text: KYORITSU KEW 4300 Simplified Earth Tester (Made In THAILAND)

The KYORITSU KEW 4300 Simplified Earth Tester (Made In THAILAND) is a handheld, simplified earth resistance tester designed for quick, two-pole measurements using existing earth electrodes (e.g. buried water pipes or building lightning rods). Its compact body houses a rotary range switch and an integral LED work‐light that automatically adapts to ambient brightness, making it ideal for field use in dimly lit areas.

Employing a constant-current fall-of-potential method, the tester injects a small AC current (≈1.4 mA at 825 Hz on the 200 Ω range; ≈0.7 mA at 825 Hz on the 2000 Ω range) between the H(C) and E terminals, then measures the voltage drop to calculate “Rx + re.” The result earth resistance plus any existing earth electrode resistance is displayed instantly; deduct any known “re” to obtain true “Rx”.

Built to withstand indoor environments up to 2000 m altitude, the KEW 4300 features a protective finger-guard, glow-in-the-dark TEST button, and a warning buzzer that sounds below 100 Ω. Its backlit LCD auto-shuts after 2 minutes, and the instrument powers off after 10 minutes of inactivity, preserving two AA alkaline cells. A live-circuit LED warns if line voltage exceeds 30 V during resistance measurement.

name: 4N25 80V Photovoltaic Output Optoisolator (Manufacturer : EVERLIGHT Electronics )
desc: The 4N25 is an 80V optoisolator by EVERLIGHT, featuring IR LED-phototransistor coupling, 5kV isolation, and DIP-6 packaging for signal isolation.

blocks.text: The 4N25 is a single-channel optoisolator that employs an infrared LED paired with a silicon phototransistor to transfer electrical signals while providing galvanic isolation. In this device, the LED emits photons when driven by an input current; these photons traverse an internal gap and strike the base emitter region of the phototransistor, producing a proportional collector current. This optical coupling ensures that high-voltage or noisy input circuits remain electrically separated from sensitive output circuitry, enhancing system reliability and safety.

Packaged in a compact 6-pin dual-in-line (DIP) format, the 4N25 features wide lead spacing for improved creepage distance and is also offered in surface-mount variants for high-density layouts. Internally, pins 1–2 connect to the infrared LED anode and cathode, while pins 4–5 serve as the emitter and collector of the output phototransistor (pin 6 is the base, typically left open). When an input current of up to 60 mA flows through the LED, the phototransistor switches on, allowing currents up to the device’s maximum collector-emitter rating of 80 V to pass.

Designed for harsh environments, the 4N25 withstands repetitive isolation tests at 5 kV rms and operates across –55 °C to +110 °C. Its robust construction meets UL, VDE, CSA, and multiple international approvals, making it ideal for industrial power-supply regulators, digital logic interfaces, and microprocessor signal isolation.
Available in standard and surface-mount 6-pin DIP packages (4N25, 4N26, 4N27, 4N28 series).

name: MC14530B IC
desc: Dual five-input CMOS majority-logic gate with control input, diode-protected I/O, 3–18 V supply, and TTL-drive capability in a 16-pin package.

blocks.text: The MC14530B is a dual five-input majority‐logic gate implemented in CMOS. It evaluates five logic inputs (A–E) and a control input (W), outputting “1” when three or more of A–E are “1,” then gating that result with W. Conversely, it outputs “0” when three or more inputs are “0,” regardless of W. Diode protection on every input guards against static discharge, and the device can directly drive two low-power TTL loads or one low-power Schottky‐TTL load.

Constructed with complementary P-channel and N-channel enhancement-mode MOSFETs, the MC14530B features matched pull-up and pull-down networks for balanced rise/fall times. Its high-impedance inputs accept voltages from –0.5 V up to VDD+0.5 V, while output stages source and sink up to ±10 mA. A wide supply range (3 V to 18 V) allows flexible system integration. Unused inputs must be tied to VSS or VDD; unused outputs remain open.

By embedding majority logic in a single 16-pin package, the MC14530B simplifies both combinational and sequential designs—reducing component count compared to discrete gates. Its protection circuitry and broad voltage tolerance enhance reliability in noisy or mixed-voltage environments. Typical applications include custom flip-flops, multivibrators, and programmable‐logic modules where compact, high-fan-in logic functions are required.

name: TOSHIBA TA8189N  Amplifier Linear Device DIP-12
desc: Quad BJT preamplifier IC for double-cassette recorders with EQ switching, mixing output, and ALC, in a compact 12-pin DIP package.

blocks.text: TOSHIBA TA8189N Amplifier Linear Device DIP-12

The TA8189N is a monolithic bipolar-junction-transistor (BJT) quad preamplifier specially tailored for double-cassette tape recorders. It integrates four independent amplifier channels two for playback and two for recording into a single 12-pin DIP package. Playback channels include a built-in equalizer switch to select between normal and metal tape types, while recording channels feature an automatic level control (ALC) detector to maintain consistent output levels despite varying input amplitudes.

Each channel comprises a low-noise input stage with bias stabilization, a main gain stage optimized for tape head impedance, and an output stage that drives mixing or recording circuitry. The playback section provides a MIX OUT terminal to select music from either cassette deck, and the ALC circuit in the record channels uses an external timing capacitor to set attack/release characteristics. All channels share a common ground and VCC pin, simplifying PCB layout and reducing component count.

By combining playback, recording, EQ switching, mixing, and ALC functions into one device, the TA8189N dramatically reduces board space and parts count. Its wide supply-voltage range (4.0 – 13.5 V) and robust thermal characteristics make it suitable for both portable and bench-top tape-recorder designs. With a typical weight of only 1.2 g, it supports compact, high-reliability audio systems.
Four low-noise BJT amplifier channels (2 × playback, 2 × record).

name: LA4190 – Dual 2.3W Audio Power Amplifier
desc: Dual 2.3 W audio power amplifier IC with mute, thermal and short-circuit protection, high fidelity, and low-noise operation in a compact SIP package.

blocks.text: The LA4190 is a monolithic integrated circuit designed to serve as a compact, dual-channel audio power amplifier. Each channel delivers up to 2.3 W of continuous output into a 4 Ω load when operated from a single 9 V supply. Internally, the device employs complementary Darlington output stages to achieve high gain and drive capability, while minimizing external component count. A built-in muting circuit suppresses turn-on/turn-off pops, ensuring smooth transitions.

Each amplifier channel incorporates an input pre-amp, voltage gain stage, and push-pull output stage with thermal and overload protection. Feedback is applied via externally connected resistors to set voltage gain (typically 50 dB per channel), allowing the designer to tailor frequency response and stability. The device also includes built-in biasing networks for consistent quiescent current, reducing crossover distortion across temperature.

The LA4190’s low-noise pre-amp and high ripple rejection make it ideal for battery-powered audio applications. Under-protection features such as thermal shutdown and output-short protection enhance reliability in compact systems. Available in a small 9-pin SIP package, it occupies minimal PCB area, making it well-suited for portable radios, tape recorders, and embedded audio modules.
Dual 2.3 W output per channel into 4 Ω at 9 V.

blocks.text: The DBL1034A is a dual-channel stereo audio amplifier IC housed in a compact DIP-12 package. Designed for low-power, high-fidelity applications, it delivers two independent output channels of up to 3 W each into 4 Ω speakers. Its internal architecture integrates biasing and thermal-shutdown circuitry, minimizing the number of external components required for a complete amplifier stage.

At its core, the DBL1034A employs a complementary-symmetry push-pull (class-AB) output stage that ensures low crossover distortion and efficient power delivery. The device includes built-in protection against thermal overload and short-circuit conditions. Inputs are differential, allowing easy coupling to preamplifier stages with AC-coupling capacitors, while the outputs can be configured in either single-ended or bridged-mode for higher voltage swing.

blocks.text: KYORITSU 5406A Digital RCD Tester (Made In THAILAND)

The KYORITSU 5406A Digital RCD Tester (Made In THAILAND) is a mains‑powered digital RCD (Residual Current Device) tester designed for rapid verification of protective devices in single‑phase 230 V AC or OLD‑TT systems. Instead of batteries, it draws test current directly from the circuit under test, ensuring uninterrupted operation. Five selectable test modes (×½, ×1, ×5, DC and Auto Ramp) allow checking that RCDs trip neither too readily nor too sluggishly, and to determine both trip current (IΔn) and trip time (tΔ) under standardized conditions.

A three‑LED wiring check confirms correct phase‑neutral‑earth connections before testing, enhancing operator safety. The X17-34-30A combines a standard NEMA 17 hybrid stepper motor with a 30:1 harmonic‑drive gearbox into a remarkably compact 60 mm‑long assembly. Retaining the familiar 42 × 42 mm flange and 34 mm stack, it delivers 2.2 N·m of continuous torque at just 1.4 A per phase. Unlike typical planetary gearmotors, its flex‑spline design achieves less than 2 arc‑min of backlash, providing ultra‑smooth, near‑perfect positional accuracy. This intrinsic precision eliminates mechanical “dead zones” and ensures repeatable motion under bidirectional loads.

Integrating the gearbox into the motor housing streamlines installation—no additional couplings or adapters are required—saving both space and assembly time. The effective output resolution of 0.06° further enhances trajectory smoothness without demanding extreme microstepping. With insulation class B, a maximum 80 °C temperature rise, and an ambient rating from –20 °C to +50 °C, the X17-34-30A is built for reliability. Its high torsional stiffness and minimal hysteresis make it ideal for robotic joints, precision rotary stages, and optical positioning systems. For any application where compactness, high torque density, and backlash‑free operation are paramount, this harmonic‑drive stepper offers a superior, ready‑to‑install solution.

The torque–speed curve for the X17‑34‑30A shows that at low speeds (up to about 300 RPM), the motor delivers its full rated torque between 2.2 N·m and 1.8 N·m, thanks to the harmonic‑drive gearbox maintaining near‑constant output. As speed increases from 300 RPM to 500 RPM, torque stabilizes at 1.8 N·m, reflecting the onset of electromagnetic and mechanical limits. Beyond 500 RPM, the torque falls more noticeably, reaching roughly 1.5 N·m at 800 RPM—still retaining over 68 % of its stall torque at high speeds. This profile highlights the X17‑34‑30A’s ability to provide strong, steady torque for precision, low‑speed positioning while maintaining substantial power well into its mid‑speed range for dynamic motion tasks.

blocks.text: sanwa DCM400AD Clamp Meter for Automotive Maintenance

The sanwa DCM400AD is a rugged, handheld digital clamp meter engineered specifically for automotive diagnostic and maintenance tasks. Housed in a slender, ergonomic body, it incorporates a precision AC current sensing clamp with a 25 mm jaw opening that accommodates a wide range of conductor sizes without requiring lead disconnection. The meter’s 3¾‑digit, 3999‑count LCD display is complemented by a 42‑segment analog bar graph for rapid trend observation, ensuring both accuracy and responsiveness. Its auto‑ranging capability simplifies operation by automatically selecting the optimal measurement range, while manual range override remains available for specialized applications.

A sampling rate of twice per second for digital readings and twenty times per second for the analog bar graph guarantees real‑time feedback during fluctuating current or voltage conditions. Additional convenience features include Data Hold, which freezes the displayed reading for post‑measurement review, and a Relative measurement mode for zero‑reference comparisons.

To conserve power, the DCM400AD enters standby after 30 minutes of inactivity, with a low‑battery indicator alerting the user in advance of replacement. Conforming to IEC 61010‑1 CAT III 300 V and II 600 V safety standards and rated for operation between 0 °C and 40 °C, the instrument combines durability with precision for professional automotive environments.

blocks.text: The sanwa DCM60R Digital Clamp Meter is a compact, true‑RMS AC clamp meter engineered for low‑voltage electrical diagnostics in CAT III 300 V/CAT II 600 V environments. Its Δ‑Σ sensing method and true‑RMS circuitry deliver precise current measurements across 199.9 A and 600 A ranges, while its autoranging AC voltage function spans 199.9 V to 600 V with 1999‑count resolution.

A large, easy‑to‑read LCD supports data‑hold, over‑range “OL” indication, and a continuity buzzer for sub‑100 Ω checks. Sampling twice per second, the DCM60R provides stable readings and signals battery‑low at 2.2 V. Designed for extended field use, it draws just 5 mW and runs for about 250 hours on two AAA batteries. The slim, ergonomic body incorporates a 25 mm jaw opening to suit most conductors, and a protective case stores leads and the meter conveniently.

Safety features include double/reinforced insulation, barrier guards, and compliance with IEC 61010‑1, ‑2‑030, ‑2‑032, ‑2‑033, and ‑10‑31 standards. Supplied with test leads (TL‑21a), a carrying case (C‑DCM60L), and instruction manual, the DCM60R offers portable, reliable current and voltage diagnostics for maintenance technicians and electricians in industrial and commercial settings.

name: sanwa MG1000 Digital Insulation Tester
desc: sanwa MG1000 Digital Insulation Tester delivers precise high-voltage insulation testing, ensuring safety, accurate diagnostics for electrical systems.

blocks.text: The sanwa MG1000 Digital Insulation Tester is a rugged, handheld digital insulation resistance tester designed to assess the integrity of insulation in electrical power lines and equipment up to 600 V (CAT III). Housed in a compact, IP54-rated enclosure, it combines a large backlit LCD with a 4 200‑count display and logarithmic bargraph to deliver clear, analog‑style readings. Auto‐range selection and automatic discharge ensure safe, reliable measurements, while a live‑circuit detection function inhibits tests if the circuit exceeds 30 V AC/DC.

Powered by six LR6 alkaline cells, the unit offers approximately 300 measurements per charge and enters power‑save mode after ten minutes of inactivity to conserve battery life. Built to meet IEC 61010‑1/61557 and IEC 61326 EMC standards, the MG1000 features audible and visual alarms for continuity and overload protection, as well as zero‑ohm adjustment for low‑Ω checks. Its ergonomic design, complete with a test‐lead storage compartment and wrist strap hook, makes it well‑suited for field technicians and maintenance personnel.

Delivered with test leads (TL‑112a), a strap (ST‑50), and an instruction manual, the MG1000 provides a versatile and safe solution for insulation testing in a variety of industrial and commercial environments.

name: sanwa MG500 Digital Insulation Tester
desc: sanwa MG500 Digital Insulation Tester provides accurate insulation resistance measurement, ensuring safety, efficient electrical testing performance.

blocks.text: The sanwa MG500 Digital Insulation Tester is a robust, handheld digital insulation tester designed for reliable measurement of insulation resistance in electrical installations up to 600 V under CAT III. Housed in an IP54‑rated casing with a protective overmold, it presents readings on a large backlit 4,200‑count LCD augmented by a log‑type bargraph for intuitive analog‑style feedback. With auto‑ranging across four insulation ranges (4 MΩ–4 GΩ) and selectable test voltages of 125 V, 250 V, and 500 V DC, the MG500 automatically discharges capacitive circuits upon completion, ensuring user safety.

Voltage, resistance, and insulation functions are seamlessly integrated: AC/DC volts to 600 V with auto‑detect, resistance continuity with buzzer and alarm indicator below 40 Ω, and a dedicated 40 Ω range offering short‑circuit currents ≥200 mA. Live‑circuit detection inhibits insulation tests above 30 V, triggering audible and visual alarms. Auto‑hold captures measurements upon release of the MEASURE button, while an auto‑power‑save mode preserves battery life after 10 minutes of inactivity.

Built to withstand the rigors of industrial environments operating from 0 °C to 40 °C at up to 90 % RH it draws minimal current (7 mA on voltage range) from six AA cells, delivering hundreds of insulation tests per set. The MG500’s combination of safety features, analog‑style feedback, and comprehensive test functions makes it an essential tool for electricians and maintenance professionals.

name: sanwa SE300 Non-contact Digital Tachometer
desc: sanwa SE300 Non-contact Digital Tachometer measures RPM accurately using non-contact sensing, offering safe, fast, reliable performance for industrial use.

blocks.text: The sanwa SE300 Non-contact Digital Tachometer is a lightweight, handheld digital tachometer engineered for rapid, non‑contact measurement of rotating machinery. Utilizing a visible‑light photoelectric reflection system, it detects rotational speed by aiming its lens at an affixed reflective sticker on the target, enabling accurate readings from 50 mm up to 500 mm away. Its ergonomic pistol‑grip design ensures stable one‑hand operation, while a bright backlit LCD presents five‑digit readings with clear unit indicators, minimizing user error in dim environments.

Switching between six measurement modes revolutions per minute (rpm), revolutions per second (rps), interval (ms), rotation count, rim‑speed in meters per minute (m/min), and meters per second (m/s) is accomplished via a single function key, preserving workflow continuity. Data‑hold, MAX/MIN capture, and an auto‑power‑off feature (cancelable) extend battery life and simplify long‑term monitoring. For contact measurements, an optional ENC‑3 adapter attaches directly to shafts, accommodating both contact maker and rim‑speed ring accessories.

Constructed for indoor use (up to 2000 m altitude) and rated for 5 °C–40 °C operation, the SE300 balances precision, versatility, and durability making it ideal for maintenance technicians and quality‑control inspectors in manufacturing, HVAC, and motor‑service environments.

desc: sanwa PC710 Digital Multimeter with Dual Display is True RMS tester with dual screens, delivering precise measurements, efficient performance for professionals.

blocks.text: sanwa PC710 Digital Multimeter with Dual Display

The sanwa PC710 Digital Multimeter with Dual Display is a compact, handheld digital multimeter engineered for versatile electrical diagnostics in both field and workshop settings. Housed in a robust, protective holster with a built‑in tilt stand, it features a large dual LCD that simultaneously displays primary measurements (voltage or current) alongside their frequency or AC/DC components, enhancing visibility and efficiency. Its True‑RMS circuitry ensures accurate readings across a broad array of waveform types, from pure sine waves to distorted signals and pulses. A fast‑response analog bar graph (60 updates/sec) complements the numeric display (5 updates/sec), aiding in dynamic measurements and peak capture.

The unit’s auto‑ranging capability simplifies operation across voltage, current, resistance, capacitance, and temperature functions (–50 ℃ to 1000 ℃ via included K‑type thermocouple), while manual-ranging and data‑hold features offer user control in complex testing scenarios. Innovative electric‑field detection modes (non‑contact and probe contact) assist in locating live conductors and identifying wiring faults without circuit disconnection.

Additional recording modes (Crest Capture, MAX/MIN/AVG) and relative measurement expand its analytical utility. An optical USB interface (with optional KB‑USB7 adapter and PCLink7 software) enables real‑time data logging and analysis on a PC. Designed to IEC 61010 CAT III 600 V/CAT II 1000 V safety standards, the PC710 balances ruggedness, accuracy, and functionality for professionals and enthusiasts alike.

On-screen tools including multiple measurement points, lines, rectangles, and circles allow immediate hotspot analysis, while isotherm modes (Auto, Manual, Above, Below, Section, Ratio) help isolate specific temperature bands. Integrated Wi-Fi (paired via NFC) and Bluetooth allow seamless data transfer to the companion app for further analysis, and a built-in LED flashlight plus buzzer facilitate work in low-light conditions.

Running on a rechargeable 1800 mAh Li-ion battery (≥ 2.2 hours runtime with Wi-Fi off) and backed by IP54/1 m drop protection, the UTi720T is designed for field technicians who need a reliable, all-in-one thermal solution.

blocks.text: The UNI-T UT725 multifunction process calibrator is a handheld, battery-powered instrument designed to streamline a variety of calibration tasks in industrial environments. At its core, it combines both a temperature process calibrator and a loop-calibrator into a single tool, enabling technicians to both source and measure key process signals without switching devices. Users can generate and read out milliamp (mA) loops, DC voltage, temperature via thermocouples or RTDs, resistance, frequency, and more—all from the same unit. The UT725’s intuitive interface and clear LCD allow real-time simultaneous measurement and output of different process parameters, minimizing steps when verifying or troubleshooting transmitters, sensors, and control loops.

Built with a rugged housing and powered by six AA rechargeable batteries, the UT725 is portable enough to carry into tight plant spaces or take out in the field for on-site work. Its precision sourcing and measurement accuracy (down to 0.02 %) ensure that loop calibrations, transmitter checks, and temperature verifications meet exacting standards. Contrast adjustment and an auto-power-off feature help extend battery life, while onboard storage lets users save and recall up to several custom setups. For advanced tasks, a USB port enables communication with a PC for data logging or firmware upgrades.

Overall, the UT725 is tailored for maintenance engineers and technicians who need a single, reliable instrument to handle loops, temperature, frequency, and resistance calibrations across diverse industrial applications.

Unlike its predecessor, the UT255B incorporates a built-in 433 MHz wireless transmitter and companion receiver that deliver real-time measurement data up to 20 meters away, enabling technicians to monitor readings from a safe distance without interrupting field operations.

Designed around the latest CT and electromagnetic-screening technologies, the UT255B delivers high accuracy down to microampere-level currents, making it particularly effective for identifying incipient insulation faults or moisture ingress in surge arresters. Its ergonomic housing balances light weight with rugged durability, ensuring stable performance in harsh outdoor environments. An intuitive interface guides users through peak-hold, data-hold, and memory-save functions, allowing transient spikes or low-level leakage currents to be captured and reviewed later.

The clamp mechanism itself can be quickly released by a simple rod-retraction action, streamlining repeated measurements along long transmission runs. By marrying precise low-current sensing, wireless data transmission, and high-voltage insulation safety, the UT255B stands as a versatile diagnostic tool for power-system maintenance teams.

name: PCF8574 I2C I/O Expansion Module
desc: The PCF8574 I2C I/O Expansion Module adds 8 digital I/O pins to microcontrollers via I2C, ideal for expanding GPIO capabilities in embedded projects.

blocks.text: The PCF8574 I²C I/O Expansion Module is designed to extend the input/output capabilities of microcontrollers through the I²C interface. It provides 8 quasi-bidirectional GPIO pins (P0–P7), allowing each pin to function as either an input or output without the need for a separate data-direction control signal. This flexibility makes it suitable for various applications, including driving LEDs, reading switches, and interfacing with sensors.

The module features an open-drain interrupt output (via INT pin), enabling efficient monitoring of input changes without continuous polling. Multiple PCF8574 modules can be connected on the same I²C bus, with configurable addresses (via A0–A2 pins) allowing up to 8 devices, thereby expanding the I/O count to 64. Its low power consumption and compatibility with 3.3 V and 5 V systems make it an excellent choice for embedded and battery-powered applications.

name: UNI-T UT620A Digital Micro Ohm Meter
desc: The UNI-T UT620A is a high-precision digital micro ohm meter designed for accurate low-resistance measurements in industrial and electrical applications.

blocks.text: UNI-T UT620A Digital Micro Ohm Meter

The UNI‑T UT620A is a precision digital micro‑ohm meter designed for accurate low‑resistance measurements in constrained environments. It employs a true four‑wire (Kelvin) measurement method to eliminate lead and contact resistance errors, delivering high‑resolution readings down to 10 µΩ. A large LCD display with backlight ensures legibility in dimly lit areas, while a built‑in lithium‑ion battery provides hours of untethered operation.

Key features include a high/low limit comparison function that alerts users when measured values fall outside preset thresholds, enabling rapid go/no‑go testing. The meter can also calculate unknown wire lengths in feet or meters, making it ideal for verifying cable runs. Data hold, relative (zero) mode, and automatic power‑off enhance usability and conserve battery life. Up to 1,000 measurement results can be stored internally, and bidirectional USB connectivity allows seamless two‑way data transfer between the meter and a PC for trend analysis.

With a measurement range spanning from 10 µΩ up to 6 kΩ across multiple current levels (10 mA to 5 A), the UT620A balances wide dynamic range with up to ±(0.25 % + 25) basic accuracy in its lower ranges. This combination makes it suitable for applications such as:
Transformer and motor winding resistance checks, ensuring coil integrity and detecting shorted turns.
Welding joint inspections, verifying contact quality in critical assemblies.
Busbar and cable connectivity tests in power distribution cabinets.
Metal coating resistance measurements, confirming plating uniformity.
Automotive and PCB trace resistance verification in repair and manufacturing settings.

Rugged yet compact (370 × 90 × 290 mm), the UT620A comes with Kelvin clips, test leads, USB cable, power adapter, software CD, and an English user manual. Its thoughtful design, extensive feature set, and robust data management capabilities make it an essential tool for electricians, maintenance engineers, and quality‑control technicians requiring fast, reliable low‑resistance diagnostics.
Four‑Wire (Kelvin) Measurement: Eliminates lead/contact resistance for precise low‑Ω readings.
High/Low Limit Alarm: Comparison function with upper and lower thresholds for quick go/no‑go tests.
Wire‑Length Calculation: Converts resistance into length (m/ft) to verify cable runs.
Built‑in Lithium‑Ion Battery: 7.4 V / 4000 mAh for hours of portable use.
1 000‑Group Data Storage: Internal logging for later recall and analysis.
USB PC Connectivity: Bidirectional data transfer (HID‑compliant) for real‑time monitoring and trend analysis.
Data Hold & Relative (Zero) Mode: Freeze the display and zero‑out test leads for differential measurements.
LCD Backlight: Ensures readability in dim environments.
Auto Power‑Off & Low‑Battery Indicator: Conserves power and warns when recharging is needed.

name: UNI-T UT512D Insulation Resistance Testers
desc: UNI-T UT512D is a 2.5 kV insulation resistance tester ideal for high-voltage equipment diagnostics, with PI/DAR, data logging, and USB connectivity.

blocks.text: The UNI-T UT512D is a digital high-voltage insulation resistance tester tailored for professionals in industries like electric power, telecommunication, and meteorology. It features multiple test voltage ranges—250V, 500V, 1000V, and 2500V—each adjustable in 10% steps, offering flexibility and precision for diverse testing needs. Key functionalities include polarization index (PI) and dielectric absorption ratio (DAR) measurements, vital for evaluating insulation quality over time. The tester supports various modes, such as continuous insulation resistance measurement, timer measurement, and comparison measurement, enhancing its versatility.

The UT512D boasts an insulation resistance measurement range from 0.25MΩ to 1.0TΩ, with accuracies as precise as ±(5%+5) in specific ranges. It delivers a short-circuit current of approximately 3.5mA and measures leakage current automatically. Beyond insulation testing, it can assess AC voltages up to 750V and DC voltages up to 1000V, making it a multifunctional tool for electrical diagnostics. Safety features are robust, including automatic discharge after testing, a high voltage alarm, and a monitoring function that prevents testing if the voltage exceeds 36V, safeguarding both the device and the operator.

Equipped with a clear LCD display, the UT512D shows real-time data such as output voltage, insulation resistance, and leakage current, with a backlight for low-light conditions. It stores up to 999 data sets, transferable to a PC via USB for analysis, streamlining fieldwork and reporting. Weighing about 1800g and measuring 238 x 166 x 90.5 mm, it’s portable yet durable, powered by 8 LR14 alkaline batteries. Accessories like test leads and a USB cable are included. Ideal for testing cables, motors, transformers, and more, the UT512D ensures the safety and reliability of electrical systems, making it indispensable for electricians and engineers.

name: UNI-T UT501E Fast Insulation tester

blocks.text: The UNI-T UT501E Fast Insulation Tester is a compact, handheld instrument designed to streamline the process of measuring electrical insulation integrity. Housed in a robust, impact-resistant casing with an IP54 rating, the UT501E accommodates both indoor and field-based environments, enabling technicians to carry out rapid insulation assessments across a variety of equipment and installations. Its streamlined form factor, combined with an intuitive rotary switch and clearly labeled terminals, facilitates quick setup and straightforward operation, reducing the learning curve for new users while maintaining reliability for seasoned professionals.

At its core, the UT501E employs high-precision circuitry to generate test voltages up to 1 000 V and deliver them into the insulation under test, all while maintaining leakage currents below safety thresholds. An analog bar graph and segmented LCD provide real-time visual feedback of both insulation resistance levels and test voltages, and an automatic discharge mechanism ensures the tested circuit returns to a safe state immediately upon test completion. Built-in safeguards, such as external voltage detection, prevent inadvertent testing on live circuits, thereby mitigating risk and enhancing user confidence during critical maintenance tasks.

Beyond raw measurement capability, the UT501E integrates practical conveniences that simplify workflow. A remote-controlled test lead allows initiation and termination of measurements without direct contact with the instrument, ideal for hard-to-reach or hazardous areas. Data-hold functionality preserves readings on the display after test completion, while onboard storage can archive up to 99 test results for later review or transfer. Rechargeable lithium-ion power and auto power-off further extend operational readiness, ensuring the tester remains available when and where rapid insulation diagnostics are required.

In sum, the UNI-T UT501E combines speed, safety, and portability in a single package, offering electrical engineers and maintenance personnel a versatile solution for verifying insulation health, diagnosing potential faults, and maintaining system reliability without compromising on measurement accuracy or ease of use.

At the heart of the display module lies a 2.4-inch full-view TFT color LCD that automatically reorients itself with gravity, ensuring that readouts remain upright whether the unit is held vertically, horizontally, or at an angle. Surrounding the screen, three rubber-tactile buttons offer intuitive access to power, measurement modes, and flashlight or screen-lock functions without obscuring the view or requiring menu diving. An integrated LED lamp, activated by a long press on the flashlight button, bathes poorly lit measurement points in bright, focused light eliminating the need for external illumination and speeding workflow in dim environments.

UNI-T’s industrial designers encase the unit in a rugged plastic shell with gently chamfered corners and a stippled grip zone, balancing toughness against fatigue-resistant handling during extended inspections. The sensor head itself is machined to a low profile and may be equipped with either short or long probes (or, uniquely for the UT312A, a U-shaped magnetic mount) to accommodate flat, irregular, or hard-to-reach surfaces.

Power is delivered via a 3.7 V/1350 mAh rechargeable lithium pack, accessed and topped up through a USB-C port. A discreet LED charge indicator glows red during charging and green at completion, while the unit’s firmware gracefully dims and shuts off the backlight after brief inactivity preserving battery life without sacrificing responsiveness when you return to the task at hand.

Together, these design choices make the UT312A more than a mere readout instrument; it feels like an extension of the technician’s hand nimble, clear-eyed, and ready to tackle vibration diagnostics anywhere at any hour.

name: UNI-T UT311A Vibration Testers
desc: The UNI-T UT311A is a compact, handheld vibration tester for fast, accurate monitoring of machinery health with acceleration, velocity, and displacement modes.

blocks.text: The UNI-T UT311A is a compact, palm-sized instrument designed to bring professional-grade vibration analysis into the hands of every technician and engineer. Encased in a durable, lightweight housing barely larger than a smartphone, the UT311A balances portability with robust construction, allowing it to withstand the rigors of daily industrial use. Its integrated piezoelectric sensor is tuned for high sensitivity, capturing subtle oscillations in machinery with impressive precision. The operator is greeted by a crisp 2.4-inch TFT color display that automatically rotates to stay upright regardless of orientation, ensuring measurements remain legible even in tight spaces or awkward angles.

From the moment it’s powered on, the UT311A exudes intuitive simplicity. A single-handed grip positions the thumb naturally over the primary controls, while minimal button presses transition seamlessly between acceleration, velocity, and displacement modes. Behind this ease of use lies sophisticated signal processing electronics that filter out noise and present only the most relevant data. In bright sunlight or dimly lit engine rooms, the built-in backlight and onboard flashlight guarantee that the display and measurement point are always clearly visible.

Ergonomics extend beyond the user interface. The UT311A’s battery is thoughtfully integrated to provide up to twelve hours of continuous operation on a single charge, and the inclusion of both long and short probes means technicians need carry only one device to cover a wide range of measurement scenarios. Magnetic mounting accessories can be affixed to permanent fixtures for hands-free monitoring, further reducing setup time and operator fatigue.

By merging precision sensing, streamlined controls, and rugged portability, the UNI-T UT311A transforms vibration inspection from a specialized task into a routine check that can be performed by maintenance teams of any size. Its design philosophy champions speed and simplicity without compromising accuracy, making it an indispensable tool for ensuring the smooth operation of pumps, motors, gearboxes, and other rotating machinery.

name: UNI-T UT275 Clamp Earth Ground Tester
desc: The UNI-T UT275 is a clamp-on earth ground tester that quickly measures ground resistance and leakage current without disconnecting the ground system.

blocks.text: UNI-T UT275 Clamp Earth Ground Tester

The UNI‑T UT275 is a clamp‑on earth ground tester designed to simplify and accelerate the measurement of grounding systems in a wide variety of electrical installations. Unlike traditional ground resistance testers that require disconnection of grounding conductors and auxiliary stakes, the UT275’s hinged jaw allows technicians to slip the meter around a grounding conductor or rod and obtain a reading instantly, without interrupting service or compromising safety. Internally, the instrument generates a small test current through the conductor under test and measures the resulting voltage drop; from this it computes ground resistance with a resolution down to 0.001 Ω, making it sensitive enough to detect even minor degradations in grounding integrity.

Ergonomically, the UT275 balances ruggedness and convenience. Its jaws open wide enough to encompass conductors up to 32 mm in diameter, while the double‑insulated housing provides both impact resistance for field use and protection against electrical hazards up to CAT III 300 V. The rotary selection knob and large four‑digit LCD ensure that readings are not only easy to select but also unambiguous under varying light conditions, thanks to an integrated backlight. All essential information resistance value, measurement range, status indicators, and low‑battery warning is presented simultaneously, thereby reducing the need for mode switching or additional manual verification.

In addition to earth resistance measurement, the UT275 can measure leakage currents up to 30 A, enabling comprehensive diagnostics of both grounding and insulation faults in a single tool. Its auto‑range and auto‑calibration functions further streamline the process: the meter adapts instantly to the detected signal level and self‑adjusts its zero point to maintain accuracy over time and temperature. Data hold and recall functions allow the operator to capture transient events or review past readings without returning directly to the test point.

Built for portability, the UT275 weighs just over 1.3 kg and is powered by four standard 1.5 V batteries, giving it several hours of continuous use. Whether servicing industrial substations, verifying the safety of building grounding networks, or troubleshooting stray currents, the UT275 offers a swift, non‑invasive, and reliable solution to earth ground testing.

name: UNI-T UT71E Intelligent Digital Multimeters
desc: UNI-T UT71E is a high-precision True RMS digital multimeter with dual displays, data logging, USB interface, and power measurement for advanced diagnostics.

blocks.text: The UNI-T UT71E is the flagship model in the UT71 series of intelligent digital multimeters, marrying precision measurement with advanced usability. Housed in a robust, ergonomically contoured case, the UT71E offers a generous 4¾-digit main display and dual 4,000-count secondary displays, ensuring that readings remain crisp and legible even in low-light or fast-changing conditions. A variable backlight can be toggled between two brightness levels or set to switch off automatically, balancing visibility with battery conservation .

Internally, the UT71E employs true RMS circuitry across its voltage and current ranges, affording accurate readings on both sinusoidal and distorted waveforms. This accuracy is complemented by an intelligent limit-setting function: users can define upper and lower thresholds, and the meter will audibly and visually alert whenever measurements stray beyond these bounds—an invaluable safeguard during mass-production testing or system commissioning . Under the hood, a high-speed microprocessor orchestrates auto-ranging, peak-hold capture, and a fast-responding analog bar-graph, delivering both detailed readouts and an intuitive, real-time sense of signal behavior.

. Power management is similarly polished: the meter will automatically shut off after an idle interval (customizable via its setup menu), and a low-battery icon prompts timely replacement of its single 9 V battery.

Physically, the UT71E is designed for both bench and field use. Rated CAT III 1000 V and CAT IV 600 V, it is built to withstand the demands of industrial environments. A knurled rotary switch, tactically separated function buttons, and a rigid tilt-stand combine to make measurements both rapid and comfortable. In the UT71E, UNI-T has crafted a tool that transcends basic electrical measurement—delivering intelligent, connected, and reliable performance for today’s complex testing needs.

The MG90S Micro Servo Continuous Rotation 360° (Full Metal Gear) is a compact and powerful servo motor designed for small-scale robotics and automation projects requiring continuous motion. Unlike standard servo motors that rotate only 180°, this version is modified to rotate freely in both directions, making it ideal for applications such as robotic wheels, camera sliders, conveyor systems, and pan-tilt mechanisms.

Built with high-quality metal gears, the MG90S offers durability and wear resistance, ensuring a longer operational life compared to servos with plastic gears. Its full metal gear construction also allows it to handle more torque and stress without stripping or failing under moderate loads. Despite its small size, it provides sufficient torque for driving lightweight robotic platforms and other moving parts.

The MG90S operates on a standard 4.8V to 6V power supply and is compatible with popular microcontrollers like Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and others through simple PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) signals. The direction and speed of rotation are controlled by varying the pulse width — typically, 1.5 ms stops the motor, pulses less than 1.5 ms rotate it in one direction, and pulses above 1.5 ms rotate it in the opposite direction.

This servo comes with a standard 3-pin connector (Signal, VCC, GND) and is easy to integrate into a variety of electronics projects. Its compact form factor makes it especially suitable for space-constrained builds like mini-robots, remote-controlled toys, or animatronics.

Overall, the MG90S 360° continuous rotation servo combines durability, versatility, and ease of use, making it an excellent choice for hobbyists, students, and developers looking to add controlled motion to their creations in a small package.

blocks.text: The Current Sensor 5A AC – 1 Phase is a versatile and essential device used to monitor and measure the current flowing through a single-phase alternating current (AC) circuit. It is specifically designed to measure current up to 5 amps, making it ideal for low-power applications such as household appliances, small machinery, and energy monitoring systems.

One of the main features of this sensor is its ability to measure AC current, which fluctuates in both direction and magnitude over time. This is particularly important for applications where power consumption varies, such as in lighting systems, small motors, and residential power networks. The sensor provides real-time current readings, enabling users to monitor their energy usage or prevent overloads.

The single-phase design makes it suitable for standard residential and small commercial environments, where power is typically supplied in a single-phase system. This type of system is common in areas where electricity demand is not extremely high, unlike industrial sectors that rely on three-phase power for larger equipment.

The sensor’s output is often analog, typically in the form of voltage (such as 0-5V) or current (like 4-20mA), which corresponds directly to the measured current. This allows easy integration with microcontrollers, energy meters, and other monitoring systems. Some models may also provide digital outputs (e.g., I2C or SPI), offering even more flexibility for data acquisition and control systems.

These sensors are commonly used in energy monitoring systems, overcurrent protection, industrial machinery, and renewable energy applications like solar panels. By helping track current levels, they ensure devices operate within safe limits, thus preventing damage due to overcurrent conditions. They are also useful in home automation systems for managing energy efficiency.

In summary, the Current Sensor 5A AC – 1 Phase is a reliable, accurate, and cost-effective tool for monitoring current in single-phase AC circuits, ensuring better energy management and equipment protection.

name: STC-1000 Digital Temperature Controller 110-220VAC with Transformer
desc: STC-1000 is a digital temperature controller with heating/cooling modes, dual relay output, and a built-in transformer for 110–220V AC systems.

blocks.text: STC-1000 Digital Temperature Controller 110-220VAC with Transformer

The STC-1000 Digital Temperature Controller is a reliable, compact, and versatile device designed to precisely manage temperature in various applications. Operating on 110–220V AC and equipped with a built-in transformer, it offers stable performance and ease of integration into both residential and commercial setups.

This controller features dual relay outputs, allowing it to independently control heating and cooling devices based on user-defined temperature thresholds. It is ideal for systems where precise climate control is critical, such as in aquariums, incubators, greenhouses, fermentation chambers, and refrigeration units.

The STC-1000 is equipped with a high-precision NTC sensor that provides accurate real-time temperature readings. The sensor is typically waterproof and extends up to 1 meter, making it suitable for humid or submerged environments. Users can set a target temperature range, and the controller will activate either the heating or cooling relay as needed to maintain that range.

The user interface consists of a 3-digit LED display and simple control buttons, making configuration straightforward, even for beginners. Key programmable features include hysteresis control, compressor delay protection, and temperature calibration, offering added safety and customization.

Its panel-mount design allows for easy installation in control panels, DIY systems, or custom enclosures. With its built-in transformer, it simplifies wiring and eliminates the need for an external power supply, especially in 220V setups.

Whether you’re managing a sensitive environment for living organisms, fermenting beverages at a consistent temperature, or automating a climate-sensitive system, the STC-1000 delivers dependable performance with great value.

blocks.text: The STC-1000 HW-524B is a compact and versatile digital temperature controller designed to offer reliable, accurate, and automated temperature control in a variety of environments. Equipped with a dual relay output, the STC-1000 can control both heating and cooling devices simultaneously. This dual-functionality allows users to maintain a precise temperature range by activating either a heater or a cooler depending on the ambient temperature and configured setpoints. The unit features a 3-digit LED display and simple button-based interface, enabling easy setup of temperature setpoints, hysteresis (differential value), and compressor delay time. These programmable parameters give users fine-grained control over how and when the relays are activated, preventing short cycling and improving the life expectancy of connected devices.

Included with the controller is a waterproof NTC temperature sensor (typically with a 1-meter cable), which provides accurate real-time readings for precise control. blocks.text: The 2S-2H C005 Digital Timer Delay Module (5V) is a compact and intelligent electronic module designed for precise timing control of electrical devices. It allows users to set a customizable delay ranging from 2 seconds (2S) to 2 hours (2H), making it highly versatile for various applications in automation, DIY electronics, and smart control systems.

Operating at a safe and low voltage of 5V DC, this module is easy to integrate with popular microcontroller platforms such as Arduino and Raspberry Pi. This allows the module to directly control high-power devices like lights, fans, pumps, or motors. The module supports multiple operation modes, including Delay ON (relay activates after a delay), Delay OFF (relay deactivates after a delay), loop cycling, and one-shot pulse timing, depending on the specific version of the firmware.

Common use cases include automated lighting systems, irrigation control, motor start delay, and other time-based automation tasks in both residential and industrial settings. The module’s user-friendly interface and reliable performance make it ideal for both beginners and experienced electronics enthusiasts.

In summary, the 2S-2H C005 Digital Timer Delay Module offers a reliable, adjustable, and easy-to-use timing solution. With its wide time range, strong relay output, and compatibility with low-voltage systems, it is a practical component for a wide variety of timing and automation needs.

name: Encoder Wheel 20 Slots 26mm
desc: The Encoder Wheel 20 Slots is a rotating disk with 20 slots, used to generate pulses for tracking rotation, speed, and position in robotics and motion system.

blocks.text: The Encoder Wheel – 20 Slots is a simple yet effective mechanical component used to detect rotational motion in motors and wheels. It consists of a circular disk with 20 evenly spaced slots or cutouts, designed to work with an optical or infrared sensor. As the wheel rotates, these slots pass between a light source and a detector, allowing light to intermittently reach the sensor. Each time a slot passes through the sensor’s detection area, it generates a digital pulse. With 20 slots, the wheel provides 20 pulses per full rotation, making it suitable for low-resolution motion tracking and rotational feedback.

This encoder wheel is often made from lightweight materials like plastic or acrylic, ensuring it doesn’t add significant load to the motor shaft. It typically has a central hole that allows it to be mounted directly onto a motor shaft, making it a convenient choice for robotic and automation projects. The spacing and precision of the slots are critical in determining the accuracy of the encoder system.

The Encoder Wheel – 20 Slots is widely used in DIY electronics, robotics, educational projects, and entry-level automation systems. It’s ideal for applications such as measuring wheel rotation, calculating distance traveled, or monitoring the speed of a DC motor. When combined with a microcontroller like Arduino or Raspberry Pi, it can be used to build simple yet functional closed-loop control systems.

Although it provides a relatively low resolution compared to high-slot encoder wheels, it is perfect for basic feedback systems where high precision isn’t essential. It offers a balance of simplicity, affordability, and practical functionality, making it an excellent tool for students, hobbyists, and makers exploring motion detection and control.

name: SL-888 Electric Kettle Thermostat Switch 10A
desc: The SL-888 Electric Kettle Thermostat Switch 10A controls temperature, preventing dry boiling, ensuring safety, and offering durability for electric kettles.

blocks.text: The SL-888 Electric Kettle Thermostat Switch 10A is an essential component designed to regulate and control the temperature inside electric kettles, ensuring safe operation and efficient performance. This thermostat switch plays a critical role in preventing dry boiling, which can damage the appliance or lead to safety hazards. By automatically disconnecting the power when the water reaches the boiling point, it helps maintain both the longevity of the kettle and the safety of the user.

Typically, the SL-888 switch is rated for 10A current and operates within the voltage range of 220V to 250V, making it suitable for most household electric kettles. It features a high-temperature tolerance and can withstand temperatures up to 125°C, ensuring reliable performance in demanding conditions. The thermostat is designed with a long service life of up to 10,000 cycles, which guarantees durability and long-term functionality.

This switch is built with dry boil protection, which is a critical safety feature. When the water inside the kettle boils, the thermostat automatically cuts off the power supply, preventing the kettle from running dry, which can cause severe damage to the heating element. This feature not only enhances safety but also reduces energy waste by stopping the kettle from operating once the water is fully heated.

Additionally, the SL-888 thermostat switch is built to endure high voltage, withstanding 2200V AC for one minute without damage, ensuring it can handle electrical surges and voltage spikes common in household power systems. Certified with CE, TUV, and CCC, this product meets strict safety and quality standards.

name: DC Step Down Module 16-120VDC to 12VDC 3A
desc: The DC Step Down Module 16-120VDC to 12VDC 3A converts high-voltage DC to stable 12V output, ideal for powering 12V devices with up to 3A current.

blocks.text: The DC Step Down Module 16-120VDC to 12VDC 3A is a reliable and efficient power converter designed to step down high DC voltages, ranging from 16V to 120V, to a stable 12V DC output with a maximum current output of 3A. This module is highly versatile and suitable for various applications, particularly in renewable energy systems, electric vehicles, and other high-voltage DC environments where a 12V output is required for powering different devices or systems.

One of the main advantages of this step-down converter is its wide input voltage range. This makes it perfect for powering sensitive devices like LED lights, cameras, and routers that require consistent voltage to operate correctly.

With a current capacity of 3A, the module is capable of supplying a steady 12V output to devices with moderate power requirements. This feature makes it particularly suitable for off-grid power solutions or applications in electric vehicles, where high input voltages (such as those from battery packs) need to be converted to 12V for auxiliary systems like lighting, displays, and control units.

The module utilizes buck converter technology, which efficiently steps down voltage while minimizing energy loss, ensuring higher efficiency in power conversion. Additionally, it comes with built-in overcurrent and overvoltage protection, enhancing the safety of the connected devices. Its compact size makes it easy to integrate into various projects, while its durable construction ensures long-lasting performance in both indoor and outdoor environments.
Overall, the DC Step Down Module 16-120VDC to 12VDC 3A is an essential tool for anyone needing to efficiently convert high DC voltages into stable, reliable 12V power.

name: Prototyping Shield for Arduino Mega
desc: The Prototyping Shield for Arduino Mega allows easy circuit building and testing with access to all I/O pins, power rails, and a solderable prototyping area.

blocks.text: The Prototyping Shield for Arduino Mega is a versatile expansion board designed specifically for the Arduino Mega 2560 and other Mega-compatible development boards. It provides a practical platform for engineers, students, and hobbyists to design, test, and build custom electronic circuits directly on top of the Arduino board. This shield simplifies the process of prototyping by offering a dedicated area to solder components, reducing clutter and keeping everything well-organized.

One of the most notable features of the shield is its large prototyping area, which includes a grid of solder pads compatible with both through-hole and some surface-mount components. This gives users flexibility in designing their circuits. Many versions of the shield also come with a removable mini breadboard, allowing temporary circuit setups without soldering—ideal for testing before making permanent connections.

The shield aligns with the full pin layout of the Arduino Mega, which offers significantly more digital and analog I/O pins compared to standard Arduino Uno boards. This ensures easy access to all of the Mega’s capabilities while prototyping. Additional features often include reset and power indicator LEDs, a general-purpose push button, and sometimes areas for adding ICs (integrated circuits) using DIP sockets.

Power distribution is simplified with built-in rails for 5V and GND, allowing multiple components to be powered directly from the shield. The solder pads are typically labeled for easy identification, which speeds up the building and troubleshooting process.

Overall, the Prototyping Shield for Arduino Mega is an essential tool for anyone looking to expand their projects beyond simple breadboard experiments. It is ideal for creating more permanent or semi-permanent circuits while maintaining a clean and stable connection to the Arduino Mega board. Whether for learning, experimenting, or developing prototypes, this shield adds great value to the Arduino ecosystem.

name: Glass Fuse 3.15A 250V T5x20mm
desc: Glass Fuse 3.15A 250V (T5x20mm) is a slow-blow fuse ideal for protecting electronic devices from overcurrent, allowing brief surges without breaking.

blocks.text: The Glass Fuse 3.15A 250V (T5x20mm) is a vital safety component widely used in electronic and electrical circuits to protect against overcurrent and short-circuit conditions. This specific fuse is designed to handle currents up to 3.15 amps and voltages up to 250 volts AC, making it suitable for medium-power devices and general-purpose protection applications. Its time-delay (slow-blow) characteristic allows it to tolerate temporary current surges—such as those occurring when a device first powers on—without immediately blowing, which prevents nuisance interruptions.

Constructed in a 5x20mm glass body with metal end caps, this fuse allows for easy inspection to visually confirm if the fuse element has melted. The glass housing also provides excellent insulation and stability, while the compact size ensures compatibility with a wide range of PCB-mounted or in-line fuse holders. Its physical format conforms to international safety and dimensional standards, making it interchangeable across many brands and circuit designs.

The slow-blow feature of this fuse makes it ideal for applications involving inductive loads such as motors, transformers, or power supplies, where inrush currents are common. It ensures the circuit is only interrupted when a sustained overcurrent occurs, thus providing both protection and operational reliability.

Typical applications for this fuse include home appliances, battery chargers, power adapters, audio systems, LED drivers, and industrial control equipment. It is widely preferred in situations where both current protection and tolerance to brief surges are necessary.

In summary, the Glass Fuse 3.15A 250V (T5x20mm) offers a dependable and cost-effective solution for circuit protection. Its standard size, slow-blow behavior, and visual clarity make it a popular choice for engineers and technicians looking to safeguard electronic devices from overcurrent damage while ensuring stable performance.

name: HW-519 TTL to RS485 Converter Module
desc: The HW-519 TTL to RS485 Converter Module allows bidirectional communication between TTL devices and RS485 networks, ideal for industrial and automation systems.

blocks.text: HW-519 TTL to RS485 Converter Module

The HW-519 TTL to RS485 Converter Module is a versatile and efficient device used to convert TTL (Transistor-Transistor Logic) serial communication to RS485 differential signal for long-distance and noise-resistant data transmission. This module is commonly used in industrial automation, sensor networks, Modbus communication, and other systems where reliable, robust communication over extended distances is crucial.

The HW-519 module offers automatic direction control, which eliminates the need for manual toggling of RE/DE pins found in traditional RS485 modules like the MAX485. This simplifies the setup and operation of the converter, making it easier to implement in projects without the need for additional control signals or hardware.

Designed to support both 3.3V and 5V logic levels, the HW-519 module is highly compatible with a wide range of microcontrollers, including Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, and more. It is equipped with indicators like TXD and RXD LEDs that show the status of data transmission and reception, providing valuable feedback for debugging and operation.

One of the standout features of the HW-519 is its built-in 120Ω termination resistor. This resistor can be enabled through the R0 jumper to terminate the RS485 bus, ensuring stable communication over long distances (up to 1200 meters) and preventing signal reflection, which can degrade data quality. Automatic Direction Control: The module automatically manages data direction (send/receive) without requiring manual control. This feature greatly simplifies system setup, as users don’t need to manually toggle control pins during communication.

Enhanced Data Integrity: Thanks to the built-in 120Ω termination resistor, the HW-519 ensures stable, noise-resistant data transmission over long distances, preventing issues like signal reflections that could degrade data quality.

Versatile Use Across Devices: Supporting both 3.3V and 5V logic levels, the HW-519 is adaptable to a wide variety of microcontrollers and embedded systems, making it a highly flexible solution for different projects.

Real-Time Feedback: Equipped with RXD and TXD LED indicators, the module provides visual feedback about data reception and transmission. This feature helps users quickly verify that data is being transmitted correctly, which is particularly useful for troubleshooting.

Built-in Protection: The module comes with integrated protection mechanisms, like TVS diodes and polyfuses, which shield the system from electrical surges, ensuring greater durability and reliability in harsh operating conditions.

Compact and Simple Design: The module’s small size makes it easy to integrate into various systems without taking up much space, while its straightforward design ensures that it’s user-friendly and accessible for both beginners and experienced developers.

name: T265 Intel RealSense Tracking Camera
desc: The Intel RealSense T265 is a compact tracking camera with 6DoF, using VIO for accurate, real-time localization without GPS or external markers. Availability: From 2 to 4 weeks

blocks.text: The T265 Intel RealSense Tracking Camera is a compact and powerful tracking solution designed to provide accurate and reliable 6 degrees-of-freedom (6DoF) positional tracking for robotics, drones, and other mobile devices. It leverages Intel’s proprietary Visual Inertial Odometry (VIO) technology, combining input from dual fisheye cameras and an Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) to track position and orientation in real-time. The T265 features an Intel® Movidius™ Myriad™ 2 VPU, enabling on-board processing of the tracking data without relying heavily on a host system’s computational power. This makes it ideal for low-power and edge computing applications.

The camera is designed for inside-out tracking, meaning it does not require any external sensors or markers to determine its location. Its small form factor and USB 2.0/3.0 interface allow for easy integration into a variety of platforms. The T265 excels in environments where GPS is unreliable or unavailable, such as indoors or in urban canyons, providing consistent tracking performance even under challenging lighting and motion conditions.

Although the T265 has been discontinued, it remains popular among developers and researchers for its ease of use, plug-and-play functionality with the RealSense SDK 2.0, and its ability to enhance autonomous navigation and SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) applications.

name: UNI-T UT25CL Cable Locator
desc: ​ UNI-T UT25CL Cable Locator detects conductors, traces underground cables, locates fuses, and identifies short circuits or interruptions in walls.

blocks.text: UNI-T UT25CL Cable Locator comprises two handheld modules a transmitter (UT25CL-T) and a receiver (UT25CL-R). Designed for meticulous detection tasks, it enables professionals to trace both energized and de-energized cables. With the transmitter’s signal, the receiver can track wiring paths inside walls, beneath floors, or even underground, helping you locate wires, identify shorts or open circuits, and find fuses accurately. The powerful combination of visual and audible indicators ensures precise cable tracking without guesswork.

Equipped with both a backlit LCD and integrated flashlight on both modules, the UT25CL excels in dim or confined spaces. It offers single-pole and dual-pole tracking modes, accommodates standard energized wire diagnostics up to 480 V (AC/DC), and enables non-contact voltage (NCV) detection in energized circuits. The receiver can handle signals from up to eight transmitters simultaneously, making it well-suited for complex installations or multi-circuit layouts.

Practical and robust, the locator supports both automatic and manual sensitivity scanning to adapt to various environments and cable conditions. Users can adjust signal strength via transmitter “levels” and maintain clarity by minimizing cross-talk. It’s CE-certified and built to withstand typical field conditions. From renovation and maintenance to troubleshooting concealed wiring, the UT25CL offers reliability and visibility when tracking hidden electrical infrastructure.
Find conductors inside the wall, and detect conductor interruptions or short circuits.
Locate fuses and devices associated with the fuses.
Identify short circuits and open circuits in the underfloor heating(metal).
Trace metal water pipes and metal heating pipelines.
Adjust the sensitivity of the receiver automatically or manually (3 adjustable levels).

name: Arduino UNO R4 Minima board (Clone) Type-C
desc: Arduino UNO R4 Minima board (Clone) Type-C is a compact, Type-C-powered development board with enhanced performance, ideal for versatile electronics projects.

blocks.text: Arduino UNO R4 Minima board (Clone) Type-C

Arduino empowers makers’ creativity and passion for innovation with a robust new board that’s perfect for all users, from beginners to experts – allowing anyone to easily connect to the internet and create IoT projects. Your user-friendly, accessible UNO just took a quantum leap forward: Arduino UNO R4 is a 32-bit microprocessor offering more speed, memory, connectors and connectivity options than any version of the board before. Out of this world, and into the future.

Arduino’s continued commitment to making technology accessible to everyone was the inspiration behind Arduino UNO R4 Minima: the new addition to the brand’s community-supported ecosystem offers powerful technology at an affordable price. Packing more computational power, memory and speed in the familiar form factor of the UNO at 5V operating voltage, it allows users to easily upgrade projects made with the UNO R3 or the Leonardo. What’s more, thanks to a RA4M1 microcontroller by Renesas, it can leverage two new off-the-shelf peripherals, CAN BUS and (12 bit) DAC: perfect for automation or audio projects.

UNO R4 Minima is armed with a powerful 32-bit microcontroller courtesy of Renesas. Brace yourself for increased processing power, expanded memory, and a whole new level of on-board peripherals. The best part? Compatibility with existing shields and accessories remains intact, and there’s no need to make any changes to the standard form factor or 5 V operating voltage.
Features of Arduino UNO R4 Minima board (Clone) Type-C

Hardware compatibility with UNO form factor: The UNO R4 Minima retains the UNO R3’s form factor, pinout, and 5 V operating voltage. By utilizing the vast and distinctive ecosystem already developed for the Arduino UNO, guarantees a seamless transition for current shields and projects.

Expanded memory and faster clock: Prepare for more accurate computations and the capacity to manage challenging projects with ease thanks to the increased RAM and quicker clock. With more memory and a quicker clock speed, the UNO R4 Minima gives you the ability to complete difficult jobs with ease.

Extra on-board peripherals: A 12-bit DAC, CAN BUS, and OP AMP are just a few of the new on-board peripherals that the UNO R4 Minima offers. You have greater skills and design flexibility thanks to these extra parts.

Extended 24 V tolerance: The UNO R4 Minima now allows power supply up to 24 V and has a larger input voltage range. By using a single power supply, this enables smooth connection with motors, LED strips, and other actuators, simplifying your projects.

SWD connector: Every project needs to have a robust debugging process. Simply connect an external debugger to the UNO R4 Minima to monitor your system’s internal operations. Maintain control while gaining insightful knowledge.

HID support: When connected to a computer using a USB cable, the UNO R4 Minima may emulate a mouse or keyboard thanks to built-in HID (Human Interface Device) functionality. The usability and functionality of a computer are improved by this practical feature, which makes it simple to convey keystrokes and mouse movements to a computer.
Overview of Arduino UNO R4 Minima board (Clone) Type-C
Block Diagram of Arduino UNO R4 Minima board (Clone) Type-C
Pinout of Arduino UNO R4 Minima board (Clone) Type-C

blocks.v: Input voltage from VIN pad / DC Jack · 6 · 7.0 · 24 · V

blocks.text: The Arduino board offers multiple power supply options:
VIN Pin: Power can be provided through the VIN pin.
Barrel Jack: An alternative is to use the barrel jack.
USB-C Connector: The board can also be powered via the USB-C connector.

When power is channeled through the VIN, the ISL854102FRZ buck converter efficiently steps down the voltage to 5 V. Both the VUSB and the barrel jack connector, along with the VIN pins, are directly linked to this ISL854102FRZ buck converter.
When powering the board via USB, it’s worth noting that the RA4M1 microcontroller receives approximately ~4.7 V, a slight reduction due to the Schottky diode drop.

The UNO R4 Minima operates at 5V, and this applies to all the pins on the board with the exception of the 3.3V pin. This specific pin sources its power from the VCC_USB pin on the R7FA4M1AB3CFM#AA0. Notably, it is not linked to the buck converter.
The GPIOs of the R7FA4M1AB3CFM#AA0 microcontroller are designed to handle a maximum current of 8 mA. It’s crucial to avoid connecting devices that demand a higher current directly to these GPIOs.
For powering external devices that necessitate greater power, such as servo motors, always opt for an external power supply.

desc: CYPRESS CYALKIT-E04 EVK enables battery-free, ultra-low-power IoT applications using energy harvesting, ideal for wireless sensors and smart devices.

blocks.text: CYPRESS CYALKIT-E04 S6AE102A, S6AE103A Evaluation Kit (EVK) Energy Harvesting Power Management
The CYALKIT-E04 S6AE102A and S6AE103A evaluation kit (EVK) from Cypress Semiconductor.

The kit allows engineers to quickly and easily develop battery-free applications with an energy harvesting device using Cypress’ ultra-low-power, energy-harvesting S6AE102A and S6AE103A power management ICs (PMICs).

The Cypress CYALKIT-E04 S6AE102A and S6AE103A EVK, available consists of an S6AE102A board, an S6AE103A board, and a sensor board along with a solar module, wires, and a battery for testing different configurations.

The kit can be used as a standalone device or in conjunction with the CY8CKIT-042-BLE Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) Pioneer kit to demonstrate and develop applications that power a Bluetooth low energy device using harvested energy.

The BLE Pioneer Kit supports the Cypress PSoC Creator integrated design environment (IDE), a hardware and software co-design environment powered by a library of pre-verified and pre-characterized PSoC Components.

The S6AE102A and S6AE103A PMICs enable ultra-low power operation with quiescent currents of only 280 nA and startup power of only 1.2 μW. This enables the boards to store slight amounts of power generation from a solar cell under dark environments of approximately 100 lux, and provide power to the systems. This kit is capable of supporting the life extension of a primary battery or becoming a battery-less solution, and can be used for evaluation of diverse power management functions used for wireless sensor networks. Engineers can also connect the sensor board to the S6AE102A and S6AE103A boards to evaluate magnetic door sensor and ambient light sensor operation.

Typical architecture for energy-harvesting embedded devices that are built around the S6AE101A/2A/3A PMICs.

As soon as enough light falls on a solar cell to provide current to the device, the S6AE101xA PMIC activates and delivers energy to the system. If the system is not active, or additional energy is available at the input, the device stores the energy in a capacitor for later use.
An internally switched power block can deliver the energy from a battery or solar cell to capacitors or an adjustable output voltage LDO.
The power block inside the S6AE102A/S6AE103A device controls the state of the connections in the power inputs and outputs. Image from Cypress datasheet.
Block diagram of the S6AE102A/S6AE103A PMIC from Cypress Semiconductor Datasheet.
To learn more about these devices, AAC purchased the CYALKIT-E04, which contains evaluation boards for the S6AE102A/S6AE103A.

To learn more about the devices, I connected the S6AE103A to the solar cell provided in the kit and recorded the potential difference at test points VStore1 and VStore 2 with the Tektronix MDO3104 oscilloscope and TPP1000 probes.

For this example, SW12 was in the off position (turning off the charging indicator LED) and SW11 was in the on position (charging the onboard 0.33 F supercapacitor). Primary illumination was provided by an LED desk lamp located 30 cm above the solar cell. Secondary illumination came from a computer monitor (facing away from the solar cell) and an incandescent room light (over 2 m away).

This image shows the charging cycle time before (left eight divisions) and after (right two divisions) the LED desk lamp was turned on. As the lamp’s knob was turned to full brightness, the charge period further decreased (shown in images below). This indicates that the lamp, even at its lowest setting, was the primary source of energy.

I used a 200 s/div time-scale setting to show a large portion of the supercapacitor charge cycle. The Tektronix MDO3104 is capable of 1000 s/div; that would have illustrated much more of the charge cycle, but it would take 2 hours and 45 minutes to fill the oscilloscope screen. Even at 200 s/div you need to wait a long time; it took 33 minutes to record what is shown below.
Channel 1 (yellow) shows the voltage at the VStore1 test point, and Channel 2 (blue) shows the voltage at the VStore2 test point (i.e., the supercapacitor voltage).
Shown above is a 33-minute recording of the supercapacitor charging indoors at night via a desk lamp (Channel 2, blue). See below for better representations of the voltage at the VStore1 test point.

Energy from the solar cell is initially transferred to the capacitor connected to the VStore1 pin. When an upper voltage threshold is detected, energy is transferred from the small capacitor connected to the VStore1 pin to the supercapacitor connected to the VStore2 pin.

blocks.text: The RPLIDAR A2M12 is the 360 degree 2D laser scanner (LIDAR) solution developed by SLAMTEC. It can take up to 16000 samples of laser ranging per second thanks to its high rotation speed. The on-board system can perform 2D 360° scans within a range of 12 meters.
The core of RPLIDAR A2 runs clockwise to perform a 360 degree omnidirectional laser range scanning for its surrounding environment and then generate an outline map for the environment.

The RPLIDAR A2 consists of a range scanner core and mechanical powering parts which makes the core rotate at a high speed. When it functions normally, the scanner will rotate and scan clockwise allowing you to be able to get the range scan data via the communication interface of the RPLIDAR and control the start, stop and rotating speed of the rotation motor via PWM. The typical scanning frequency of the RPLIDAR A2 360° Laser Scanner is 10hz (600rpm) with an actual scanning frequency that can be freely adjusted within the 5-15hz range.

The RPLIDAR A2 adopts a laser triangulation measurement system developed by SLAMTEC, which makes the RPLIDAR A2 have excellent performance in multiple indoor and outdoor environments. With the low noise brushless motor and OPTMAG technology, the RPLIDAR has a ultra-long life.
SLAMTEC provides RoboStudio, a real-time monitoring tool and SDK (available for Windows, MacOS, x86 Linux and Arm Linux) to speed up the product development.

By ensuring proper wire seating and clean termination, the tool contributes to stable signal transmission and organized wiring systems.
