name: BTA24-600B Triac 600V 25A TO-220
desc: The BTA24-600B is a 24A, 600V TRIAC used for controlling AC power in applications like light dimmers, motor speed controls, and temperature regulation.

blocks.text: The BTA24-600B arrives as a compact, familiar power-semiconductor: a TO-220 package with three leads and a metal tab, its black molded body matte and purposeful. The part feels utilitarian no unnecessary ornamentation and the tab and leads announce its role as a device meant to be bolted to a heatsink and integrated into a power stage. Visually it communicates capability: the package size, the robust leads, and the stamped markings all suggest a component intended for repeated switching of AC currents.

When imagined in operation, the triac becomes an invisible gatekeeper of alternating current. It sits between mains and load, remaining inert until a gate pulse awakens it to conduct; then it carries current smoothly through its body until the current falls below holding levels. There is a mechanical-like certainty to its behavior: a predictable turn-on with a clear threshold, steady conduction while on, and an abrupt return to off when conditions change.

Installed and heat-sunk, the BTA24-600B quietly enforces power control. It does not call attention to itself except by the thermal management it requires and the loads it controls. Remove it and the circuit loses its switching capability; fitted correctly it simply does its job robust, reliable, and engineered to handle substantial AC currents in demanding environments.

Analog Discovery 2’s high-level block diagram is presented in Fig. 1 Above. The core of the Analog Discovery 2 is the Xilinx® Spartan®-6 FPGA (specifically, the XC6SLX16-1L device). The WaveForms application automatically programs the Discovery’s FPGA at start-up with a configuration file designed to implement a multi-function test and measurement instrument. Once programmed, the FPGA inside the Discovery communicates with the PC-based WaveForms application via a USB 2.0 connection. The WaveForms software works with the FPGA to control all the functional blocks of the Analog Discovery 2, including setting parameters, acquiring data, and transferring and storing data.

Signals in the Analog Input block, also called the Scope, use “SC” indexes to indicate they are related to the scope block. Signals in the Analog Output block, also called AWG, use “AWG” indexes, and signals in the Digital block use a D index – all of the instruments offered by the Discovery 2 and WaveForms use the circuits in these three blocks. Signal and equations also use certain naming conventions. Analog voltages are prefixed with a “V” (for voltage), and suffixes and indexes are used in various ways: to specify the location in the signal path (IN, MUX, BUF, ADC, etc.); to indicate the related instrument (SC, AWG, etc.); to indicate the channel (1 or 2); and to indicate the type of signal (P, N, or diff).

Accessories can be purchased separately to provide additional functionality, such as the BNC Adapter for higher bandwidth and BNC connectors, or the Breadboard Adapter and Breadboard Breakout for a direct connection to the breadboard, or the Impedance Analyzer for additional Impedance measurement functionality. The Analog Discovery 2 comes packaged in a durable project box that will fit all the included accessories and some additional adapter boards. The project box measures (7″ x 5.75″ x 1.5″) and provides even more durability when stashing your portable Oscilloscope and multi-function instrument in your backpack or briefcase.

WaveForms is the free software application for the Analog Discovery 2 and enables use of the available analog and digital instruments. The software has been refined by customer feedback for over 10 years and features a computer and laptop friendly user interface that has the feel of traditional benchtop software. The Analog Discovery 2 communicates with WaveForms via a USB connection to your computer, allowing users to capture, record, analyze, and generate mixed signal and mixed domain waveforms. WaveForms can be downloaded and installed in under 60 seconds and can be tested without hardware using its demo mode feature. In addition to the use of instruments in the application, the WaveForms application has a script editor tool, which allows custom scripting of the instrument in JavaScript. name: Wemos D1 Wifi ESP8266 Development Board with CH340 Uploader
desc: The ESP8266 D1 / R1 is a WiFi enabled processor that uses the Arduino UNO footprint.It will also work with some Uno shields.

blocks.text: ESP8266 D1 R1 WiFi Processor with Uno Footprint

The ESP8266 D1 R1 WiFi board utilizes the ESP8266 WiFi enabled processor, and puts it onto an Arduino Uno board footprint. It provides a way to work with the ESP8266 in a familiar setup and does not require a breadboard in order to make interconnections since it has the typical on-board female headers. It will also work with some Uno shields that have compatible I/O pin-outs.
KEY FEATURES OF ESP8266 D1 R1

Besides adding WiFi capability, the main claim to fame for the ESP8266 processor over the AVR processor of the standard Arduino is that it has a larger 4MB of Flash memory and runs at clock speeds of 80MHz and can sometimes optionally be overclocked to 160MHz and has a very fast processing speed.

The Digital I/O except for D0 all support PWM and interrupts. In addition they can be configured to have pull-up or pull-down resistors On the down-side, it has only 1 analog input which is probably the most significant limitation. That can always be overcome by using an external Analog Mux module like our 16-channel 74HC4067, ADS1115 4-Channel 16-bit ADC or the MCP3008-I/P 8 channel A/D converter IC below if more analog I/O is desired.

Per spec, the digital I/O is limited to 3.3V, but the ESP-8266 mfr has made statements that the digital pins are in fact 5V tolerant and there are many installations using the module directly connected to the logic lines of 5V peripherals.

Note that when programming the board, you need to refer to the I/O using both the letter and number. With Arduino, output D3 would be referred to simply as ‘3’, but with the D1 board, you need to refer to the pin as ‘D3’.
The board can be powered via the USB port or using an external 7-12V power supply via the DC Power Jack. The board runs at 3.3V, so keep that in mind when working with I/O.

name: 74LS38 Quad 2-Input NAND Buffer IC DIP-14
desc: The 74LS38 is a quad 2-input NAND buffer IC with open-collector outputs, enabling wired-AND connections and providing high current drive for interfacing.

blocks.text: The 74LS38 is a monolithic integrated circuit from the Mitsubishi Low-Power Schottky (LSTTL) family, configured as a quadruple two-input positive NAND buffer. This means a single 14-pin package contains four independent, identical logic gates. Each gate performs the fundamental NAND Boolean function, where the output is driven low only when both of its inputs are high. The “buffer” designation indicates that these gates are designed to provide higher output current capability compared to standard logic gates, making them suitable for driving heavier loads.

A defining characteristic of the M74LS38P is its use of open-collector outputs. Unlike standard totem-pole outputs which actively drive the signal both high and low, an open-collector output can only pull the signal line low to ground. When the output transistor is off, the line is left in a high-impedance state. This requires an external pull-up resistor to bring the output voltage high. This architecture is key to enabling specific system-level functions that are impossible with conventional gates.

The open-collector design allows multiple outputs to be connected together to a common bus line with a single pull-up resistor, forming a “wired-AND” configuration. This is useful for creating shared bus systems and simplifying logic. Furthermore, the outputs are characterized by a high breakdown voltage and can sink a significant amount of current, making the device versatile for interfacing with higher voltage circuits or for directly driving indicators like LEDs or small relays.

blocks.text: Mini Push Button 4-Pin (6x6x9.5mm): Compact Tactile Switch for Precise Circuit Integration

6x6x9.5mm Tactile 4 Pin Push Button Switch is widely used as a standard input button on electronic projects. These work best when you mount them on PCB but can also be used on a solderless breadboard for temporary connections in prototypes. The pins are normally open (disconnected) and when the button is pressed they are momentarily closed and complete the circuit.

This tact switch also offers reliable dome contact technology and strong tactile feedback. Applications include telecommunications, consumer electronics, audio/visual, medical devices, testing/instrumentation, and computer/peripherals.

name: Axial Lead Type Inductor 3.9uH 0.5W
desc: Axial Lead Inductor (0.5W) is a compact passive component with leads, designed to handle up to 0.5 watts for filtering and energy storage in circuits.

blocks.text: An Axial Lead Type Inductor is a type of passive electronic component that stores energy in a magnetic field when current flows through it. The “axial” refers to the lead configuration, where the leads extend from either end of the inductor, allowing for easy integration into circuits, especially on a breadboard or PCB (printed circuit board).

Inductors are an integral part of any electronic circuit as they help us to protect the circuit from the current surges that might happen of you start any high-power device and other RF interference in the circuit. But the inductors that come in different size and shapes like toroidal shaped, iron core, laminated core etc. For PCB application you need a small size inductor package that can be easily mounted to the PCB board like SMD package or this 1/2W Inductors for Through Hole Package that you can use simply as you use a resistor. You don’t have to worry about the big packaging size of the inductor and space on the PCB. They have color bands on them to read its inductance value. They do not have any polarity so that you can use them in any orientation. They can be easily used in filter applications, and in DC-DC converters etc..
An axial inductor provides inductance for small, low-power, low-current electronics projects. It is very similar in form factor with a resistor, but is usually colored green.
High quality color code inductor assortment kit and fixed Inductor.
Compact and Easy to Mount: The axial lead design allows it to be easily mounted onto PCBs or through-hole components.
Low Power Loss: The low resistance helps in reducing energy dissipation, making it efficient in handling power up to 0.5 watts.
Versatile: Widely used in electronic applications ranging from consumer electronics to industrial machinery, depending on inductance and power requirements.
Resistance: Low DC resistance to minimize power loss and heating.
Operating Frequency: Often used in low to medium-frequency applications (up to several MHz depending on the type).
Construction: The wire leads are often made of tinned copper or similar materials to ensure durability and ease of soldering.
Power Supply Filters: Used to smooth out DC voltage from rectifiers in power supplies.
Signal Filtering: Common in radio-frequency (RF) circuits, used to filter high-frequency noise or to block certain frequencies.
Inductive Coupling: Found in transformers or other energy-transfer applications.
Chokes and Transformers: In circuits where inductive properties are needed to control current flow.

Inductors are an integral part of any electronic circuit as they help us to protect the circuit from the current surges that might happen of you start any high-power device and other RF interference in the circuit. But the inductors that come in different size and shapes like toroidal shaped, iron core, laminated core etc. For PCB application you need a small size inductor package that can be easily mounted to the PCB board like SMD package or this 1/2W Inductors for Through Hole Package that you can use simply as you use a resistor. You don’t have to worry about the big packaging size of the inductor and space on the PCB. They have color bands on them to read its inductance value. They do not have any polarity so that you can use them in any orientation. They can be easily used in filter applications, and in DC-DC converters etc..
An axial inductor provides inductance for small, low-power, low-current electronics projects. It is very similar in form factor with a resistor, but is usually colored green.

blocks.text: T-type Solder Iron Tip with Blade for Remove Cell Phone Screen UV / LOCA Glue

The tool emerges as a slender, elongated attachment shaped in a “T” form, combining a flat blade with a tip designed to affix onto a compatible soldering iron. When heated, the blade becomes a controlled cutting and scraping edge, ideal for sliding beneath cured adhesive layers. There’s a certain balance in its design: rigid enough to lift or peel glue, yet precise enough to avoid damaging delicate components like LCDs, touch digitizers, or glass layers.

Once mounted and warmed, the heat transfers through the T-blade, softening or loosening the UV / LOCA glue. As the bond yields, the blade glides between layered materials—glass, frame, adhesive—enabling separation. The flat edge flushes against surfaces, preventing gouges or chips, while its thinness allows access to tight seams. Because it is relatively simple in shape, the user still guides it with care; movement must be steady to avoid scratching or cracking fragile screen elements.

Visually, the blade tip is compact, unadorned, functional. The metal holds a dull sheen, sometimes with slightly rounded edges softened from manufacture to avoid sharp burrs. The junction where blade meets tip is firm, often welded or securely fitted to resist wobble. Though not flashy, the tool’s appeal lies in its utility: delivering clean separations between glued layers, while keeping fragile display surfaces intact and ready for glue removal, cleaning, or further repair.

The SONGLE SMI-12VDC-SL-2C is a compact, sealed two-pole changeover (2-C) power relay in an 8-pin PCB package. Designed for PCB solder mounting, it packages two SPDT contact sets in one small footprint so designers can switch two independent circuits or provide double-pole switching for higher safety and isolation. The relay is intended for general power-control use where a small form factor, reliable contact switching and moderate load capacity are required.

This relay uses metal alloy contacts (options include AgCdO, AgSnO₂, AgNi) and a coil driven at 12 VDC for the SMI-12VDC variant. It is a sealed construction (S = sealed, F = dust-proof versions exist) with a spring-type contact mechanism that yields consistent make/break behaviour. Typical operate and release times are short (≤ 10 ms), enabling responsive switching in control circuits.

The SMI series is specified for wide environmental range (–40 °C to +85 °C) and rated for vibration and shock typical of industrial use. Insulation and dielectric values are high meeting reinforced insulation spacing and strong coil-to-contact dielectric withstand ratings so it is suitable where safety isolation and reliable long-term switching are needed. The relay’s small mass (~15 g) and PCB footprint make it a convenient choice for compact power/control modules.

blocks.text: Smoke and Flammable MQ-2 Gas Sensor

The MQ-2 Gas Sensor is a highly sensitive semiconductor sensor engineered to detect a wide array of flammable gases and smoke, making it an essential component for safety and monitoring applications. Its sensing element, composed of tin dioxide (SnO2), exhibits low conductivity in clean air but increases conductivity significantly when exposed to target gases such as liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), methane, propane, hydrogen, alcohol, and smoke. This characteristic enables precise detection across a concentration range of 300 to 10,000 parts per million (ppm), ensuring reliable performance in diverse environments.

The Honeywell AWM43300V Air Flow Sensor is part of the AWM40000 series, designed using advanced microbridge technology to provide accurate and reliable measurement of gas flow up to ±1000 sccm. It operates based on thermal mass flow sensing, where airflow passing over a heated microstructure causes a temperature difference that is converted into a proportional electrical output. This design ensures high sensitivity, fast response, and excellent repeatability, making it suitable for precision applications.

blocks.text: The BT138-600 Triac is a robust and versatile semiconductor device designed for controlling power in AC circuits. Rated at 600 volts and 12 amps, this triac is housed in a TO-220 through-hole package, making it ideal for a wide range of applications that involve switching or phase control of alternating current.

The 600V rating ensures safe operation under standard line voltages with sufficient overhead for transients, while the 12A current capability makes it suitable for medium-power applications.

One of the key advantages of the BT138-600 is its sensitive gate triggering, which allows it to be activated with low gate current. This means it can be controlled directly by low-power logic-level devices like microcontrollers or Optoisolator, enabling easy integration into smart control systems. The low gate current requirement also contributes to reduced heat generation and more efficient operation.

The TO-220 package offers excellent heat dissipation characteristics, thanks to its metal tab, which can be mounted to a heatsink for additional thermal management in high-power applications. This ensures the triac remains cool and reliable even under demanding load conditions.

Moreover, the BT138-600 provides high immunity to dv/dt (rate of voltage change), which helps prevent false triggering in noisy environments—an important feature for industrial and home automation systems.

Overall, the BT138-600 is a cost-effective, durable, and easy-to-use triac that combines high voltage and current handling capabilities with reliable switching performance. An audio amplifier is an electronic circuit designed to amplify weak AC or DC signals to a higher amplitude range. Amplifiers are commonly found in devices such as mono speakers, stereo speakers, and audio amplifiers. Below is an audio amplifier circuit using a 2SC5200 transistor. This audio amplifier circuit can be built with various electronic components, including a 2SC5200 NPN power transistor, a 0.5 Watt 8 Ohms loudspeaker, a 3.5mm DC male or female jack, a 10K potentiometer, a 1K resistor, a 220uF electrolytic capacitor, a 12V DC power supply, battery clips, jumper wires, and a breadboard.

name: 74LS91 8-Bit Shift Registers IC DIP-14
desc: 74LS91 IC 8-Bit Shift Register DIP-14 is a serial-in/parallel-out device used for data storage, ideal for digital circuits, counters, LED display driving.

blocks.text: The 74LS91 IC 8-Bit Shift Registers DIP-14 is an 8-bit shift register integrated circuit housed in a 14-pin DIP (Dual In-line Package) configuration. It functions primarily as a decade counter, capable of dividing the input frequency by 10, providing binary-coded decimal outputs. This IC features serial-in and serial-out capabilities, enabling the shifting of data bits serially through the register. It supports synchronous operation with a clock input and carries a reset function to clear the count. The 74LS91 is useful in digital circuits for counting, frequency division, and data storage applications, making it a versatile component in timing and sequencing circuits. Its 14-pin package incorporates all necessary inputs and outputs for interfacing with other TTL logic devices, optimized for use in digital systems requiring stable and reliable 8-bit counting or shifting operations.

The chip is designed with CMOS technology to achieve low power consumption and low output leakage current errors.

The design also includes special circuitry that provides TTL logic input voltage level compatibility. Double buffering of the device allows outputting a voltage corresponding to one digital word while holding the next digital word. This also permits the simultaneous updating of any number of DACs.

DAC0832LCN also designed with silicon-chromium R-2R resistor ladder network which divides the reference current and provides the circuit with excellent temperature tracking characteristics (0.05% of Full Scale Range maximum linearity error over temperature).

blocks.text: VICTOR REINZ REINZOSIL Universal Sealing Compound 320°C 70ml

The Material of VICTOR REINZ REINZOSIL Universal Sealing Compound 320°C 70ml is Anthracite coloured, solvent-free sealing, adhesive & coating compound based on silicone. Once completely bonded, REINZOSIL is virtually odorless.

The Properties This highly elastic universal sealing compound is resistant to all mineral oils and numerous synthetic oils, lubricants, gasoline, diesel oil, greases, hot and cold water, cleaning agents, sunlight, ozone, and sea water. There is no outgassing, i.e. no gas escapes from REINZOSIL highly elastic universal sealing compound under the effects of temperature, so it does not influence electronic sensors.

REINZOSIL is a neutral-bonding silicone, so it does not attack metallic surfaces, i.e. REINZOSIL does not trigger oxidation in its surroundings which can have negative effects on sensors, electronics, or electrical components. This makes REINZOSIL an ideal sealant for many housing components which cover sensitive electronics. This is what gives REINZOSIL its title “Sensor Safe”.
REINZOSIL can be used at temperatures from – 50 °C to + 250 °C in continuous running operation, and even as high as 320 °C for short periods of time.
Its hardness/softness ranges between 35 and 40 Shore A.
No damage to surfaces and sensors being oil-resistant, low volatility, non-corrosive, and low odor

Remove any gasket remnants or other residues such as grease, oil, etc.
with REMOVE solvent remover. Allow the surfaces to dry, then apply the sealing compound on one side manually or by means of a pneumatic spraying device. Assemble the components immediately.

Processing temperature lies between +5 °C and +40 °C. Depending on temperature and humidity, a skin develops after 5 to 12 minutes. The full curing time depends mainly on the relative air humidity (RH) and room temperature, as well as on the thickness (gap height) and width of the applied layer.

Due to its special properties, REINZOSIL is used in the most varied applications, e.g. as FIPG (formed-in-place gasket) for wet assembly, i.e. for sealing small gaps under pressure as well as for cylinder liners in piston machines, and also to compensate for extensive component warping. Moreover, the compound is also used to seal constructional
fissures or cracks, and for seals that are subjected to considerable relative movement.
Contrary to REINZOPLAST, the sealing layer is destroyed during disassembly, and a new coating is required after the surfaces have been cleaned.

The compound can also be applied to assembled components. In these cases, after the sealing joint has been cleaned and degreased, REINZOSIL is applied directly to the sealing gap, similar to the procedures used in the building industry

blocks.text: The MAX7219CNG is an 8-digit, 7-segment LED display driver DIP-24 is the IC housed in a 24-pin DIP package. The IC integrates a BCD code-B decoder, multiplex scan circuitry, segment and digit drivers, and an 8×8 static RAM to store each digit’s data. This chip simplifies LED display control by reducing the number of microcontroller pins needed to drive large displays, providing individual LED segment control, digital and analog brightness adjustment, and a low power shutdown mode that retains data. The MAX7219CNG operates with a supply voltage typically around 5V and supports a serial interface with data rates up to 10 MHz. It is widely used in applications such as digital clocks, counters, panel meters, bar-graph displays, and other LED matrix displays. Its slew-rate limited segment drivers minimize electromagnetic interference, enhancing display quality and reliability. The device is suitable for common-cathode LED configurations. These Infrared Photodiodes detect IR light and are used for IR remote control or IR obstacle avoidance and intrusion sensors.
Dark lens to reduce visible light interference
Infrared (IR) is the light spectrum that is commonly used for IR remotes and is outside the visible spectrum for the human eye.
These Photodiodes are used to detect the presence of IR which may be from an IR remote control, an IR emitter LED or even an open flame which also emits IR.

A photodiode is a semiconductor device that converts an optical signal into an electrical signal. The core of the diode is also a PN junction, which differs in structure from a normal diode in that the PN junction area is made as large as possible to facilitate the reception of incident light, the electrode area is kept as small as possible and the junction depth of the PN junction is very shallow, generally less than 1 µm.

When used as an IR remote control for something like a robot, the IR is typically pulsed at a modulated rate of 38kHz to created coded messages. Different manufacturers have different transmission protocols for these coded messages. There is a library that can be used with Arduino called IR Remote. if you are looking to create a standard remote control or other communication link that can make use of standard codes.

The FZH 211 is a bipolar integrated circuit that combines four independent two-input NAND drivers in a single P-DIP-16 package. Each gate has an open-collector output and an extra N input to support wired-AND connections and simple delay circuits. The device is designed primarily as a driver and level converter for interfacing different logic families.

A notable capability of the FZH 211 is automatic threshold changeover: the input threshold can be switched to LSL, TTL, or CMOS levels depending on the supply voltage used. That flexibility allows the IC to translate between logic families without extra external circuitry, making it suitable where mixed-level systems must be bridged.

blocks.text: ESP32-PICO-D4 is an ESP32-based System-in-Package (SIP) from Espressif. The ESP32 at the heart of the package has a Tensilica Xtensa dual-core 32-bit LX6 microprocessor, with 448KB of ROM and 520KB of SRAM (including 8KB of RTC memory), and a 1KB eFuse. The SIP module integrates 4MB of SPI Flash memory, although as the ESP32 can support up to 16MB it’s possible we might see that in future revisions. Wireless connectivity support is 802.11 b/g/n/e/i (802.11n up to 150 Mbps), alongside Bluetooth V4.2 (BR/EDR and Bluetooth LE support).

The module interfaces include an SD card, UART, SPI, SDIO, LED PWM, Motor PWM, I2S, I2C, IR, as well as GPIO, capacitive touch sensor, ADC, DAC, and an LNA pre-amplifier. The chip also has two onboard sensors—a Hall sensor to detect magnetic fields, and a temperature sensor. Its small footprint and reduced number of external components make it perfectly suited for wearables and other Internet of Things devices.

name: MC68B40P Programmable Timer Module 5V DIP-28 (Wide)
desc: The MC68B40P is a programmable timer module commonly used for event counting, frequency measurement, pulse generation, interval timing, and interrupt control in microprocessor-based systems.

blocks.text: The MC68B40P, also known as the MC6840 Programmable Timer Module (PTM), is a versatile timing and control IC designed for use with Motorola M6800 family microprocessors and other digital systems. The device integrates three independent 16-bit programmable timer/counters, each with its own control register, allowing precise timing operations, event counting, and interrupt generation. It provides a flexible hardware solution for applications that require accurate time measurement and control.

The PTM can be configured for a wide range of functions including frequency measurement, pulse-width measurement, interval timing, square-wave generation, gated delay generation, and event counting. With programmable interrupt capability and multiple clocking options, the MC68B40P is widely used in industrial controllers, embedded systems, instrumentation equipment, communication devices, and legacy computer systems.

The UPC319C High Speed Dual Comparator IC is designed to perform accurate voltage comparisons between two input signals and produce a digital output depending on which input is higher. It integrates two independent high-speed comparators in a single DIP-14 package, making it suitable for compact circuit designs that require fast response and reliable signal processing.

This IC is widely used in analog signal conditioning, waveform shaping, and voltage level detection circuits. Thanks to its fast response time and stable operation, the UPC319C is often applied in control systems, oscillators, pulse generation circuits, and sensor signal processing. The DIP-14 through-hole package makes it easy to install on breadboards and PCBs for prototyping or production designs.

desc: A MC6821P versatile peripheral interface adapter IC used to connect microprocessors with external digital devices through programmable parallel input/output ports.

blocks.text: MC6821P Peripheral Interface Adapter 5V IC DIP-40

The MC6821P Peripheral Interface Adapter (PIA) is a programmable parallel I/O integrated circuit designed to provide an efficient interface between microprocessors and peripheral devices. It features two independent 8-bit bidirectional data ports, allowing a processor to communicate with switches, keyboards, displays, printers, relays, and other digital hardware. The device was widely used with Motorola 6800-series microprocessors and became a popular component in early computer systems, industrial controllers, and embedded designs.

The MC6821P includes programmable control registers, interrupt capabilities, and flexible handshaking functions, enabling reliable communication with external equipment. Its ability to handle both input and output operations while generating interrupts makes it suitable for real-time control systems and legacy computing applications. Today, it remains valuable for retro-computing projects, educational purposes, and the maintenance of vintage electronic systems.

Press and hold the S+ button, and then insert the module into the power supply. At this time, switch whether to turn on the key lock and save the state after power-on. If the key lock is unlocked, it must be unlocked to adjust the voltage after power-on to prevent misoperation.
After power on, press and hold S+ button without letting go, then press S- button, and unlock when there is a button lock.
After powering on, press and hold S- button without letting go, then press S+ button to lock the button.
Quick start: Plug the board into the PD power supply. At this time, the LED light indicates the current setting decoy voltage. If it is not on, it is the default 5V.

Adjust the output voltage: The board is locked by default, and you need to unlock it first. The method is to press and hold S+ button and then press S- button. At this time,the unlocking is complete and you can release the button. Then click S+ button to increase the voltage or click S- button to decrease the voltage.
Instructions for Use of Test Function

Press S- button and S+ button at the same time and then power on, the module enters the test mode, and the output voltage will automatically cycle from 5V>9V>12V>15V>20V. The voltage change time can be adjusted by S+ button and S-button, in seconds.
This function is a test function, the mode is not saved, and the switching time can be saved.

name: 74HC245 Octal Bus Transceiver, 3-State, 20-Pin SO-20
desc: The 74HC245 is an 8-bit bidirectional bus transceiver commonly used to transfer, buffer, and isolate digital data between two parallel buses.

blocks.text: The 74HC245 is an octal bidirectional bus transceiver with three-state outputs, designed for communication between two 8-bit digital buses. It contains eight data channels and uses a DIR input to select the direction of data transfer and an active-low OE input to enable or place the bus outputs into a high-impedance state. This makes it useful for controlling access to shared data buses and preventing bus conflicts.

The device uses CMOS logic technology and supports a wide supply-voltage range from 2.0 V to 6.0 V. The 74HC245 provides non-inverting outputs, low power dissipation, and high noise immunity. The specified SO-20 version is housed in a 20-lead small-outline package and is suitable for compact PCB designs.

Data Input/output (B0-B7) · These 8 pins can be used as 8-bit Input or 8-bit Output pins based on the state of DIR pin

blocks.text: The 74HC245 is an 8-bit transceiver IC with 3-state output. Meaning it has two set of pins (A0-A7 and B0-B7), in which each set has 8 pins. Out of these two sets one set can be used as input and the other set can be used as output. Since the IC is a transceiver IC, Data can flow from input bus to output bus and also from output bus to input bus, by simply toggling the Direction pin (DIR) pin as required. It also has a decent output current of 35mA and hence can be used to drive nominal loads.

So if you are looking for an IC to act as a buffer or as a transceiver for your address or data bus. Or if you are looking for an IC to act as a 8-bit logic level converter then 74HC245 IC might be the right choice for you. It is also possible to use this IC for establishing communication protocol buses (SPI, IIC, etc.) between two different MCU/MPU with different operating voltages since the IC has high speed buffer. The 3 State at which 74HC245 IC can operate is shown in the table, the pins OE and DIR can be used as follows to set the state.

74HC245 IC has a vast application; however for simplicity let us consider we are using the IC to act as logic level converter. Many hardware like Raspberry Pi, MSP430 operates with a voltage of 3.3V, but other sensors or IC’s like Ultrasonic sensor, TFT LCD displays etc operate in 5V. So in these cases we have to shift one set of operating voltage (3.3V) to another set (5V). In these cases we employ a logic level converter; the simplest logic level converter is a potential divider. But it is not efficient for high speed operation or for bi-directional communication buses. Hence in those cases a bi-directional transceiver IC like 74HC245 seems to be an ideal choice.

blocks.text: Pressure Plastic Electric Water Solenoid Valve 12V 1/2″ Normally Closed

This 12 V plastic-body solenoid valve with 1/2″ (nominal) porting is designed for on/off control of water flows under modest pressure. Constructed with a molded plastic body and coil assembly, the valve remains closed by default (normally closed) and opens when the 12 V DC coil is energized. Its compact layout and thread-in connections make it convenient for irrigation systems, small pumps, hobby projects and fluid automation setups.

When power is applied to the coil, the internal plunger lifts and allows fluid to pass through the valve body from inlet to outlet; when power is removed, the spring returns the plunger to the seat and the fluid flow stops. It uses a one-way flow design (fluid only flows in the correct direction) and a gasket arrangement to enforce a minimum pressure head and prevent back-flow.

Because the body is plastic rather than brass or metal, the valve is lightweight, corrosion-resistant and well suited to water environments (rather than aggressive chemicals or high-temperature fluid). The nominal 1/2″ connection makes it easier to integrate into piping systems with standard fittings. The 12 V DC coil design allows low-voltage switching and simplifies control via relays or microcontroller drivers in embedded systems, making the valve a versatile component for automated water control.

name: SN75179BP Differential Driver And Receiver Pair IC

blocks.text: The SN75179B is a differential driver and receiver pair designed for balanced transmission-line applications and meets TIA/EIA-422-B, TIA/EIA-485-A, and ITU Recommendation V.11. The device is designed to improve the performance of full-duplex data communications over long bus lines. The SN75179B driver output provides limiting for both positive and negative currents. The receiver features high input impedance, input hysteresis for increased noise immunity, and input sensitivity of ±200 mV over a common mode input voltage range of –7 V to 12 V. The driver provides thermal shutdown for protection from line fault conditions. Thermal shutdown is designed to occur at a junction temperature of approximately 150°C. The SN75179B is designed to drive current loads of up to 60 mA maximum. The SN75179B is characterized for operation from 0°C to 70°C.

name: IRFZ44N N-Channel Power MOSFET Transistor 49A-55V-17.5mΩ TO-220
desc: The IRFZ44N is a 49A, 55V N-channel power MOSFET with a 17.5mΩ Rds(on) in a TO-220 package, ideal for high-efficiency power switching applications.

blocks.text: IRFZ44N N-Channel Power MOSFET Transistor 49A-55V-17.5mΩ TO-220

The IRFZ44N is a N-channel MOSFET with a high drain current of 49A and low Rds value of 17.5 mΩ. It also has a low threshold voltage of 4V at which the MOSFET will start conducting. Hence it is commonly used with microcontrollers to drive with 5V. However a driver circuit is needed if the MOSFET has to be switched in completely.
Rise time and fall time is about 60ns and 45ns respectively.
It is commonly used with Arduino, due to its low threshold current.
Note: Complete Technical Details can be found in the IRFZ44N datasheet given at the end of this page.

blocks.v: Gate · Controls the biasing of the MOSFET
Drain · Current flows in through Drain
Source · Current flows out through Source

blocks.text: The IRFZ44N is known for its high drain current and fast switching speed. Adding to that it also has a low Rds value which will help in increasing the efficiency of switching circuits. The MOSFET will start turning on with a small gate voltage of 4V, but the drain current will be maximum only when a gate voltage of 10V is applied. If the mosfet has to be driven directly from a microcontroller like Arduino then try the logic level version IRLZ44N mosfet.
Difference between IRLZ44N and IRFZ44N Mosfet

The IRLZ44N and IRFZ44N MOSFETs are often confused among each other and used incorrectly. The IRLZ44N is a Logic level Mosfet with a very low gate threshold voltage of 5V, meaning the MOSFET can be fully turned on with just 5V on its gate pin which avoids the need for a driver circuit.

The IRFZ44N on the other hand requires a gate driver circuit if the MOSFET has to be turned on completely using a microcontroller like Arduino. However it does turn on partially with direct 5V form a I/O pin, but the output drain current will be limited.

Unlike transistors MOSFET’s are voltage controlled devices. Meaning, they can be turned on or turned off by supplying the required Gate threshold voltage (VGS). IRFZ44N is an N-channel MOSFET, so the Drain and Source pins will be left open when there is no voltage applied to the gate pin. When a gate voltage is applied these pins gets closed.

If it is required to be switched with Arduino, then a simple drive circuit using a transistor will work to provide the required gate voltage to trigger the MOSFET to open fully. For other switching and amplifying applications, a dedicated MOFET Driver IC is required.

If the MOSFET gate pin is directly connected to an I/O pin of a microcontroller like Arduino, PIC, etc. Then it will not open completely and the maximum drain current will depend on the voltage applied to the gate pin. The below graph shows how much drain current is permitted for gate threshold voltage from 4V to 10V.
As you can see the MOSFET opens completely only when the gate voltage is around 10V. If it is somewhere around 5V then the drain current is limited to 20A and so on.

blocks.v: COIL1 · Drawn from one side of the coil

blocks.text: Similar to PIN CONFIGURATION, DPDT relay features changes depending on MODEL. Here we are considering HK19F as a standard relay model.
Relay COIL voltage for turning ON: 24V
Maximum current allowed through each POLE pins: 1A
Operate Time (Time taken for the each POLE to move second position after powering COIL):6ms
Release Time (Time taken for the each POLE to return to Initial position after withdrawing power from COIL ): 4ms
Maximum load the relay can handle: 60Watt
Note: Complete technical information can be found in the DPDT Relay Datasheet linked at the bottom of this page.

HK19F has many replacements like GSSH212T, HF11F, and HJR12C. We need to check parameters carefully before replacing. Replacing without taking voltage and current handling capabilities may lead to permanent damage.
For understanding the use of DPDT consider:

Case1: Where you want to isolate HIGH VOLTAGE LOAD CIRCUIT from SENSITIVE CONTROL CIRCUIT. Say you want to TOGGLE a 220V AC LIGHT provided logic by CONTROL CIRCUIT, at that time using a DPDT relay is ideal. This issue can also be solved by TRAIC but there will be electrical contact between HIGH VOLTAGE LOAD CIRCUIT and SENSITIVE CONTROL CIRCUIT. So there will be not only be noise for CONTROL CIRCUIT, there will be high voltage leak to the CONTROL CIRCUIT in case of fault. So for isolating load circuit and protecting the control unit from voltage fluctuations we use DPDT relay.

Case2: Say you want to trigger a TOGGLE (ON and OFF) two different HIGH VOLTAGE LOADS, then using DPDT is a good choice. For example we can form or clear the ELECTRICAL LOOP of 220V AC LOAD and 30V DC LOAD at the same time using DPDT relay.
DPDT relay can be divided into three segments. Each segment has electrical isolation with other. One segment consists of relay COIL. Other two segments are two POLES.
For understanding the DPDT first consider internal structure below:
In the above figure, as you can see when no power is delivered to the COIL between PIN1 and PIN8:
POLE1: PIN2 or C1 (Common of POLE1) is connected to PIN3 or N/C1 (Normally Closed Terminal of POLE1) internally.
POLE2:PIN7 or C2 (Common of POLE2) is connected to PIN6 or N/C2 (Normally Closed Terminal of POLE) internally.
Consider a circuit as shown below
In figure button is not pressed, so PIN2 connected to PIN3 and PIN7 connected to PIN6. Under those circumstances the battery BAT2 will form a closed loop with M1 MOTOR. So the MOTOR1 will rotate.
In the above figure, as you can see when power is delivered to the COIL between PIN1 and PIN8:
POLE1: PIN2 or C1 (Common of POLE1) is connected to PIN4 or N/O1 (Normally Open Terminal of POLE1) internally.
POLE2:PIN7 or C2 (Common of POLE2) is connected to PIN5 or N/O2 (Normally Open Terminal of POLE2) internally.
Consider a circuit as shown below

In figure, as button is pressed, BAT1 will provide power to COIL of relay. When the power is provided, the COIL releases a MAGNETIC FIELD. The movable levers inside the relay get attracted. These levers are movable and flexible and are placed there to close the loops. With magnetic field present, these levers leave the initial contact to form a new contact on the other side. So PIN2 connected to PIN4 and PIN7 connected to PIN5. Under those circumstances the battery BAT2 will form a closed loop with M2 MOTOR. So the MOTOR2 will rotate.

Relays are ELECTROMECHANICAL devices which contain moving parts in it. As informed earlier, inside the relay we have two small METALLIC CONTACTS which move when COIL gets powered. The CONTACTS will move back to resting place after MAGNETIC FIELD provided by COIL collapses. So the CONTACTS move inside the relay, these movements take time.

Operate Time (Time taken for the each POLE to move second position after powering COIL) is 6ms.Release Time (Time taken for the each POLE to return to Initial position after withdrawing power from COIL) is 4ms. So total time is10ms. The switching frequency should be altered depending on this timing to avoid breaking METALLIC CONTACTS.

Like any other transistor, MJE2955T has three pins namely EMITTER, BASE, and COLLECTOR. The pin configuration of MJE2955T is given below.

blocks.text: Operating and Storage Junction Temperature Range -55 to +150 °C
Note: Complete technical details can be found in the MJE2955T Transistor datasheet given at the end of this page.
How to use MJE2955T Transistor in a Circuit

The MJE2955T transistor is a very versatile transistor that can be used in many different applications. It is used in high power applications where the need to control high power lodes becomes necessary. The frequency range of this transistor is quite limited which is why it is mostly used in amplifiers, but in some cases, it can be configured as a preamplifier for a power amplifier stage. MJE2955T is a PNP Transistor hence the collector and emitter will be closed (Forward biased) when the base pin is held at the ground and will be opened (Reverse biased) when the base of the transistor is connected to the ground pin. This is where a PNP transistor differs from an NPN transistor.

As we have mentioned earlier the MJE2955T is a PNP transistor and can be used in many different applications, for that reason we have set the transistor in a common emitter configuration, and we are driving a high-power motor as load. Under initial circumstances, the button will be in open circuit condition and no current will flow through the base. With no base current, the transistor acts as an open circuit and the entire supply voltage V1 will not appear across it.

name: UNI-T UT08B Receptical Tester
desc: UNI-T UT08B is a plug-in receptacle tester for 110–125 V sockets, indicating wiring faults and offering a 6–9 mA GFCI test for outlet safety.

blocks.text: The UNI-T UT08B is a plug-in receptacle tester designed to quickly verify the correct wiring of 3-wire AC outlets. Rather than using complex instruments or needing to access internal wiring, a user simply inserts the tester into a standard socket. The device then illuminates combinations of LEDs to indicate whether the hot, neutral, and ground lines are correctly connected—or whether there are wiring faults such as reversed polarity or open circuits.

Beyond basic wiring diagnostics, the UT08B includes a GFCI / RCD test function: it can simulate a 6–9 mA leakage current to check whether a protective device (GFCI/RCD) will trip as intended. This turns the UT08B from a simple wiring indicator into a safety verification tool. The housing is molded for minimal bulk, allowing it to be carried easily, and the LED indicators are positioned for quick readability. Because it draws minimal current (≈0.3 W) during operation, it remains safe to leave inserted for short checks.

In real-world use, the UT08B becomes a go-to tool for electricians, site inspectors, and DIYers wanting a fast check before plugging in equipment. It helps identify potentially dangerous wiring faults—missing ground, reversed hot/neutral, or incorrectly wired circuits—without disassembly. The built-in GFCI test function adds a layer of safety validation. For anyone needing to verify receptacle safety in homes, offices, or commercial installations, the UT08B offers a compact, user-friendly option.

blocks.text: A 5-watt, 10 kΩ cement (ceramic / “cement type”) resistor looks like a small block of engineering compact, solid, and matter-of-fact. The body is a hard, molded ceramic (often high-alumina) with the resistance element embedded or coated and the termination caps firmly attached. Its surface is utilitarian: usually a neutral color, sometimes with painted markings that identify its resistance and tolerance. The leads emerge straight from the ends or from metal caps, ready to be soldered or mounted.

Put it into a circuit and the resistor does exactly what it promises: it converts electrical energy into heat in a predictable way. As current flows the body warms, heat spreading through the ceramic and into the surrounding air or a heatsink. Under steady load it gives off warmth rather than drama a quiet, dependable thermal presence. You can sense its role by touch (carefully): warm but not glowing, steady rather than spiky.

Mechanically the component feels durable: the ceramic and cement protect the internal element and the terminals are rugged. It’s the sort of part you install and then forget about until service or troubleshooting requires you to check it. In many designs it’s a backbone doing the heavy, unglamorous work of limiting current or dropping voltage while quietly enduring thermal and electrical strain.

The 80386, also i386 and 386, (pronounced eighty-three-eighty-six) was a family of 32-bit 3rd-generation x86 microprocessors introduced by Intel in 1985 as a successor to 80286. name: LDTM-028K Piezo Vibration Sensor with Mass
desc: DTM-028K: A high-sensitivity piezoelectric vibration sensor with customizable mass for versatile low-frequency applications.

blocks.text: Precision Vibration Detection: LDTM-028K Piezo Sensor for Advanced Applications

The LDT0-028K is a flexible component comprising a 28 μm thick piezoelectric PVDF polymer film with screen-printed Ag-ink electrodes, laminated to a 0.125 mm polyester substrate, and fitted with two crimped contacts. As the piezo film is displaced from the mechanical neutral axis, bending creates very high strain within the piezopolymer and therefore high voltages are generated. When the assembly is deflected by direct contact, the device acts as a flexible “switch”, and the generated output is sufficient to trigger MOSFET or CMOS stages directly. If the assembly is supported by its contacts and left to vibrate “in free space” (with the inertia of the clamped/free beam creating bending stress), the device will behave as an accelerometer or vibration sensor. Adding mass, or altering the free length of the element by clamping, can change the resonant frequency and sensitivity of the sensor to suit specific applications. The multi-axis response can be achieved by positioning the mass off-center. The LDTM-028K is a vibration sensor where the sensing element comprises a cantilever beam loaded by an additional mass to offer high sensitivity at low frequencies.

Providing all radio functions except VHF tuning, the ULN2204A AM/FM radio system excels in low-cost applications requiring a minimal parts count and high performance. In the AM mode of operation, the device is a complete single conversion superheterodyne broadcast or shortwave receiver with AGC and peak envelope detection. In the FM mode, the ULN2204A operates as a high-gain IF amplifier/limiter and phase-shift detector. A simple dc switch is used to change the mode of operation.

A single external capacitor at pin 16 provides the AM-AGC time constant, the FM-AFC time constant, and RF decoupling. A single resistor al the same pin will adjust the AM gain for optimal system performance. The audio amplifier will work into any speaker load of 8Ω or greater. Class-B operation of the audio power amplifier yields high efficiency at the rated output with a very low quiescent power drain. The amplifier exhibits little crossover distortion. Its output impedance is significantly less than 1Ω.

The ULN2204A will work with a wide range of supply voltages and is suitable for use in AC-powered table radios and battery-powered (6V or 9V) portable radios. This system will operate at supply voltages as low as 2V at reduced volume without a significant increase in distortion. Brown-outs or weak batteries need no longer be a major concern. blocks.text: UNI-T UT345C LPG Tank Level Checker

The UT345C is a pen-style, portable ultrasonic device crafted to let users check how much liquefied gas remains in LPG bottles without needing to lift or tilt them. Its slim, handheld shape gives it the feel of a test probe; you press it against the curved side of a gas cylinder, and it communicates its reading via LED lights. Its build is designed for quick checks, not precision measurement, but for everyday use it bridges convenience and function.

When in use, you position the probe perpendicularly against different heights on the gas bottle. The unit emits ultrasonic pulses inward, detects reflections, and determines whether liquid is present at that level. Then the LED indicator lights green if liquid is present, red if not, or flashes during measurement. There’s a built-in flashlight to assist when ambient light is low, such as in darker kitchens, storage rooms, or outdoor BBQ settings. The measurement feedback is immediate, giving the user a quick sense of where the fill level lies.

In practice, the UT345C becomes a useful tool for households, gas retailers, restaurants, or campsites that rely on LPG tanks. Rather than guessing or tipping tanks, you can quickly scan levels at multiple points. Its simplicity no need for calibration, no complicated readouts makes it effective for nontechnical users. Over time, it reduces waste, ensures timely refills, and helps avoid situations where a tank runs dry unexpectedly.

blocks.text: KY-035 Digital / unipolar Hall Switch 3144 IC Magnetic Sensor Module

The KY-035 Digital Hall Switch Module with 3144 IC is a compact magnetic sensing module designed for simple on/off detection of magnetic fields. At its core is the unipolar A3144 Hall-effect sensor IC, which outputs a clear digital signal whenever a magnetic pole of sufficient strength is brought near the sensing face. Unlike linear Hall sensors that provide varying analog voltage levels, the 3144 operates as a magnetic switch: its output changes state only when the magnetic flux density crosses its operate and release thresholds, ensuring stable detection with built-in hysteresis. The module is typically powered at 5 V and delivers a clean TTL-compatible signal on its output pin, making it directly usable with microcontrollers such as Arduino, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi. With its straightforward operation and reliable switching characteristics, the KY-035 digital Hall sensor module is widely used in applications like proximity sensing, speed measurement, rotation counting, and contactless switch designs where binary detection of a magnet’s presence is required.

Visual and audio indicators help alert the operator to over-ranges, live voltage presence (NCV), or when readings exceed preset limits. Overall, the UT202BT is built to bridge the gap between everyday clamp meter functionality and modern smart-tool convenience, suitable for electricians, technicians, field maintenance, and diagnostics tasks.

blocks.text: The LinkSwitch™-TN2 family of ICs for non-isolated off-line power supplies provide dramatically improved performance compared to traditional linear or cap-dropper solutions. Designs using the highly integrated LinkSwitch-TN2 ICs are more flexible and feature increased efficiency, comprehensive system level protection and higher reliability. The device family supports buck, buck-boost and flyback converter topologies. Each device incorporates a 725 V / 900 V power MOSFET, oscillator, On/Off control for highest efficiency at light load, a high-voltage switched current source for self-biasing, frequency jittering, fast (cycle-by-cycle) current limit, hysteretic thermal shutdown, and output and input overvoltage protection circuitry onto a monolithic IC.

LinkSwitch-TN2 ICs consume very little current in standby resulting in power supply designs that meet all no-load and standby specifications worldwide. MOSFET current limit modes can be selected through the BYPASS pin capacitor value. The high current limit level provides maximum continuous output current while the low level permits using very low cost and small surface mount inductors. A full suite of protection features enable safe and reliable power supplies protecting the device and the system against input and output overvoltage faults, device over-temperature faults, lost regulation, and power supply output overload or short-circuit faults.

desc: CD4510BE is a CMOS synchronous up/down decade counter/divider, 3 V–18 V supply, 11 MHz max clock, in a 16-pin PDIP package.

blocks.text: The CD4510B, manufactured by Shenzhen Honglifa Electronics Co., Ltd., is a presettable BCD up/down counter with four synchronously clocked D-type flip-flops. It features T-type flip-flop functionality, and counters can be reset or preset via external inputs.

The CD4510B will count out of non-BCD counter states in a maximum of two clock pulses in the up mode, and a maximum of four clock pulses in the down mode. If the CARRY-IN input is held low, the counter advances up or down on each positive-going clock transition. Synchronous-cascading is accomplished by connecting all clock inputs in parallel and connecting the CARRY-OUT of a less significant stage to the CARRY-IN of a more significant stage.

The CD4510B can be cascaded in the ripple mode by connecting the CARRY-OUT to the clock of the next stage. If the UP/DOWN input changes during a terminal count, the CARRY-OUT must be gated with the clock, and the UP/DOWN input must change while the clock is high. This method provides a clean clock signal to the subsequent counting stage.

Its DIP-14 pin layout facilitates easy mounting on PCBs or breadboards, making it a versatile component for analog circuit design where matched transistor characteristics are critical. blocks.text: MN4164P-15A NMOS 65,536 x 1 Bit Dynamic RAM DIP 16-Pin

The MN4164P-15A is a dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) integrated circuit that provides 65,536 bits of data storage, organized as a single 65,536 x 1 bit array. Built using NMOS technology, it stores each bit of data as an electrical charge in a tiny capacitor within a memory cell. This dynamic storage mechanism requires the data to be periodically refreshed to maintain integrity, a key characteristic of DRAMs that allows for high-density memory structures.

This RAM is designed for easy integration into digital systems, operating from a single +5V power supply. It features a multiplexed address bus, where the 16 address bits needed to access any of the 64K locations are supplied over 8 pins, using the Row Address Strobe (RAS) and Column Address Strobe (CAS) signals to latch the row and column addresses respectively. This multiplexing significantly reduces the number of pins required, leading to a compact 16-pin DIP package.

The device supports several flexible operating modes controlled by the RAS, CAS, and WRITE pins. These include standard Read and Write cycles, a Read-Modify-Write cycle for atomic operations, and a Page Mode for faster access to multiple bits within the same row. The data output is tri-state, going into a high-impedance state when not active, allowing it to be connected directly to a shared system data bus.

blocks.text: LM2406T Monolithic Triple 9ns CRT Driver IC

The LM2406 is a high-voltage integrated CRT driver circuit intended specifically for colour monitor applications. The IC is made up of three wide-band amplifiers with high input impedance that drive the RGB cathodes of a CRT directly. Each channel’s gain is set to 14.5 internally, allowing it to drive CRT capacitive loads as well as resistive loads supplied by other applications, with the package’s power consumption being the sole constraint. The IC is housed in an 11-lead TO-220 molded plastic power package, which is industry standard. This high-voltage monolithic triple CRT driver is ideal for use with VGA and SVGA displays.

LM2406 also works at 80V and has a low power dissipation. The LM2406 has a wide bandwidth amplifier function that necessitates correct power supply bypassing for optimal operation. Large overshoot, ringing, and oscillation can occur if the power source is bypassed improperly. Internal arcing can happen on a CRT during regular operation. The maximum voltage will be limited by spark gaps of 200V–300V at the cathodes, but only to a value that is significantly higher than the LM2406 allows. In the meanwhile, the LM2406 is not utilized without a heat sink. This is because when the input signal rises, the power supply current increases, and as a result, power dissipation increases.

blocks.text: LM1203 RGB Video Amplifier System 12V 28mA DIP-28 (Wide)

The LM1203 is an integrated circuit designed as a comprehensive video amplifier system specifically for high-resolution RGB color monitors. It consolidates the critical analog signal processing chain for red, green, and blue channels into a single 28-pin package. This chip was engineered to serve as the central component between the video input signals and the cathode drivers of a CRT, handling the essential tasks of amplification and DC level control to ensure accurate and stable color reproduction on the display.

The system incorporates three wideband video amplifiers that are inherently matched for consistent performance across all three color channels. A key aspect of its design is the inclusion of three accurately matched attenuators that provide master contrast control, ensuring the relative intensity of the colors remains balanced as the overall picture level is adjusted. Furthermore, it contains three gated black level clamp comparators, which are crucial for setting and maintaining the correct brightness by clamping the video signal during the blanking interval, preventing picture drift.

To maximize performance in demanding monitor applications, the LM1203 includes a stable voltage reference for the video inputs and provides individual “Drive” adjustment pins for each amplifier. This allows for fine-tuning the gain of each channel to compensate for variations in the CRT’s cathodes or external components, ensuring precise white balance. Its output stages are designed as low-impedance drivers capable of delivering the signal levels required to drive subsequent stages, making it a robust and flexible solution for professional and high-end consumer display systems.

The ADC0816, ADC0817 data acquisition component is a monolithic CMOS device with an 8-bit analog-to-digital converter, 16-channel multiplexer and microprocessor compatible control logic. The 8-bit A/D converter uses successive approximation as the conversion technique. The converter features a high-impedance chopper stabilized comparator, a 256R voltage divider with an analog switch tree and a successive approximation register. The 16-channel multiplexer can directly access any one of 16-single-ended analog signals, and provides the logic for additional channel expansion. Signal conditioning of any analog input signal is eased by direct access to the multiplexer output, and to the input of the 8-bit A/D converter.

The device eliminates the need for external zero and full-scale adjustments. Easy interfacing to microprocessors is provided by the latched and decoded multiplexer address inputs and latched TTL TRI-STATE ® outputs.

The design of the ADC0816, and ADC0817 has been optimized by incorporating the most desirable aspects of several A/D conversion techniques. The ADC0816, and ADC0817 offer high speed, high accuracy, minimal temperature dependence, excellent long-term accuracy and repeatability, and consume minimal power. These features make this device ideally suited to applications from process and machine control to consumer and automotive applications. For similar performance 28-pin, 8-bit A/D converter, see the ADC0808, ADC0809 data sheet.

blocks.v: Emitter · Current Drains out through emitter, normally connected to ground
Base · Controls the biasing of the transistor, Used to turn ON or OFF the transistor
Collector · Current flows in through the collector, normally connected to the load

blocks.text: General Purpose Low current and Low voltage NPN Transistor

BC549 is an NPN transistor hence the collector and emitter will be left open (Reverse biased) when the base pin is held at ground and will be closed (Forward biased) when a signal is provided to the base pin. It is a low-current transistor hence the maximum amount of current that could flow through the Collector pin (Ic) is 100mA, hence we cannot connect loads that consume more than 100mA and load voltage of more than 30V using this transit. BC549 has a decent gain value of from 420 to 800; this value determines the amplification capacity of the transistor.

When this transistor is fully biased it can allow a maximum of 100mA to flow across the collector and emitter. This stage is called the Saturation Region. When the base current is removed the transistor becomes fully off, this stage is called the Cut-off Region.

The BC549 has a very low Continuous current of 100mA hence it cannot be used to switch heavy loads. But since it has a base trigger voltage of only 5V it can be easily controlled through 5V GPIO pins of Microcontrollers and Microprocessors. So it can be used in places where the load current is less than 100mA.
Apart from that the transistor can be used as an amplifier since it has a gain value from 420 to 800 and a transition frequency of 10MHz

blocks.text: SL608N Linear Slide Potentiometer 10KOhm Travel Distance 60mm

The Linear Potentiometer has a similar function as the rotary potentiometer, but instead of the semi-circular resistance, there will be a linear resistor here with a sliding contact. The two ends of the linear resistor are connected across the source or input voltage, the output is taken between the sliding contact and any end of the linear resistor. The linear pots are commonly used for measuring the voltage across a branch of a circuit, for measuring the internal resistance of a battery cell, and also for comparing a battery cell with a standard cell.

The slide pot is a single linear slider potentiometer which is also called the fader. The fader is constructed with conductive plastic. These are mostly used for audio applications and single-channel control or measurement of distance.

Connecting 24C64 EEPROM IC to a Microcontroller/Microprocessor Unit
The EEPROM IC can be easily connected to an MCU/MPU. The diagram below can be referred to as the pinout and the connections of 24C64 to an MCU/MPU.

The 24C64 communicates via the I2C bus, so the SDA and the SCL pins are connected to the Data (I2C SDA) and clock(I2C SCK) line pin of the MCU/MPU, respectively. The SCA and SDA pins on the device are open rails so to make it work as normal pins you can also connect the pins to a pull-up resistor of 4.7K ohm and connect it to the VCC and then connect to your MCU.

The 3 pins A0, A1, and A2 form the address, so can be put to the ground. The WP/WC pin can be pulled down to the ground and the VCC and GND terminal of the 24C64 IC is to be connected to the VCC and Ground terminal of the MCU/MPU to power up the IC.

Note: You can connect the A0, A1, and A2 pins to either VCC or Ground. These 3 pins decide the logic of the slave device. If you connect them to the ground, the logic is 0 and when you connect it to VCC the logic becomes 1.

blocks.text: The TPS3809 family of supervisory circuits provides circuit initialization and timing supervision, primarily for DSPs and processor-based systems. The newer TLV809E device is an alternative with the same pins, functions, and electrical parameters.

During power-on, RESET is asserted when the supply voltage VDD becomes higher than 1.1 V. Thereafter, the supervisory circuit monitors VDD and keeps RESET active as long as VDD remains below the threshold voltage VIT. An internal timer delays the return of the output to the inactive state (high) to ensure a proper system reset. The delay time, td(typ) = 200 ms, starts after VDD has risen above the threshold voltage VIT. When the supply voltage drops below the threshold voltage VIT, the output becomes active (low) again. No external components are required. All the devices of this family have a fixed sense-threshold voltage VIT set by an internal voltage divider.

The product spectrum is designed for supply voltages of 2.5 V, 3 V, 3.3 V, and 5 V. The circuits are available in a 3-pin SOT-23. The TPS3809 devices are characterized for operation over a temperature range of –40°C to 85°C.

name: Wireless 4 Channel Remote Transmitter with Receiver Module 433MHz
desc: A Remote Transmitter 433MHz RF wireless module kit featuring a four-button key fob remote and a receiver board.

blocks.text: Wireless 4 Channel Remote Transmitter with Receiver Module 433MHz

4 Channel RF remote built using PT2262 and PT2272-M4 IC. PT2262 used as Encoder (Transmitter) and PT2272-M4 Decoder (Receiver) ICs are the heart of the project. The receiver provides 4 channel Momentary outputs. All outputs are TTL level and can be interfaced with other circuits or relay boards. The transmitter works with 5V to 12V DC. The receiver works with 5V DC.

When any of the SW13-SW16 (S1-S4) tact switches is pressed, power is applied to the encoder IC and RF transmitter module, the encoder then starts scanning Jumper J1-J8 and transmitting the status of the 8 bits address and data serially. The decoder IC receives the data and compares it two times with J1-J8 address jumpers and provides outputs also VT LED goes On, if the data is Valid and the address of the Transmitter and Receiver are the same. It is important to have the same jumper settings J1-J8 at the transmitter and receiver to pair both. Multiple remotes can be used to control devices at the same location by changing the address codes. All address is Tri-State and offers 6561 combinations.

PT2262 is a remote control encoder paired with PT2272 utilizing CMOS technology. It encodes data and addresses pins into a serial-coded waveform suitable for RF modulation. The circuit uses 8 bits of tri-state address pins providing up to 6561 address codes, thereby, drastically reducing any code collision and unauthorized code scanning possibilities.

PT2272 decodes the waveform received and fed into the DIN pin. The waveform is decoded into code word that contains the address, data, and sync bits. The decoded address bits are compared with the address set at the address input pins. If both addresses match for 2 consecutive code words, PT2272 drives the data output pins whose corresponding data bits the decoded to be a 1-bit, and (2) the VT output — to a high state.

When PT2272 receives a transmission code word, it initially checks whether this is a valid transmission. For transmission to be valid, (1) it must be a complete code word, and (2) the address bits must match the address set at the address pins. After two consecutive valid transmissions, PT2272 (1) drives the data pins according to the data bits received, and (2) raises VT to a high state.

An LM741 operational amplifier is a DC-coupled high-gain electronic voltage amplifier. It has only one op-amp inside. An operational amplifier IC is used as a comparator which compares the two signals, the inverting and non-inverting signal. The main function of this IC is to do mathematical operations in various circuits. Op-amps have large gain and are usually used as a Voltage Amplifier. The LM741 can operate with a single or dual power supply voltage.
An op-amp can be used in two ways:

When the input source is connected to inverting terminal PIN 2 and feedback with the output PIN 6 then the op-amp is in inverting condition. Like if PIN 2 is having +ve polarity then we will get –ve polarity of output from PIN 6.

When the input source is connected to non-inverting terminal PIN 3 and PIN 2 is feedback with the output PIN 6 then the op-amp is in non-inverting condition. For if PIN 3 has +ve polarity then we will get +ve polarity of output from PIN 6.

When the voltage at the non-inverting input (+) is higher than the voltage at the inverting input (-), then the output of the comparator is HIGH. And if the voltage of inverting input (-) is Higher than the non-inverting end (+), then the output is LOW. The output of the operational amplifier is the product of the gain and the input voltage.

blocks.text: The SPX3819 is a positive voltage regulator with a low dropout voltage and low noise output. In addition, this device offers a very low ground current of 800μA at 100mA output. The SPX3819 has an initial tolerance of less than 1% max and a logic-compatible on/off switched input. When disabled, power consumption drops to nearly zero. Other key features include reverse battery protection, current limit, and thermal shutdown. The SPX3819 includes a reference bypass pin for optimal low-noise output performance. With its very low output temperature coefficient, this device also makes a superior low-power voltage reference.

The SPX3819 is an excellent choice for use in battery-powered applications such as cordless telephones, radio control systems, and portable computers. It is available in several fixed output voltage options or with an adjustable output voltage.
This device is offered in 5-pin SOT-23-5 packages.

blocks.text: UrsaLeo UrsaCloud UltraLite Development Kit offers a turnkey, Google Cloud-connected platform for data management. The Development Kit allows users to manage sensors, store, visualize, and process data, access Google’s cloud tools such as Big Query analytics, and set event-based alerts for user-defined and automatic conditions.

The UrsaCloud UltraLite Development Kit includes the NXP Semiconductors iMX6UL Development Board (MCIMX6UL-EVKB), the Silicon Labs Thunderboard Sense 2 Sensor Board (SLTB004A), and a Murata Wi-Fi® LAN + Bluetooth® Module (LBEE5KL1DX-TEMP-DS-SD). Also included is a portable router pre-configured to communicate with the NXP Board. On power up, the UrsaLeo software connects the NXP Board to the Thunderboard Sense 2 Sensor Board and collects data on the 10x Sensors over a BLUETOOTH® connection. The UrsaCloud UltraLite Kit processes encrypts, and transmits the data via a portable router to the Google Cloud, where it is displayed on a pre-configured dashboard.

Sensors included in the UrsaCloud UltraLite Development Kit are Temperature, Humidity, Pressure, Ambient Light, UV Light, 3-axis Gyroscope, Microphone, Air Quality, Air Volatile Organic Compound Levels, and Magnetic Field Strength.

name: Cyber:bot Robot Kit – with Micro:Bit
desc: Cyber:bot Robot Kit with Micro:Bit for Python robotics, STEM education, sensor circuits, servo control, and hands-on coding projects.

blocks.text: Cyber:bot Robot Kit – with Micro: Bit

The Cyber:bot Robot Kit – with Micro:Bit is an educational robotics platform designed for students, makers, and STEM learning environments. It combines the BBC micro:bit module with the Parallax cyber:bot board and small robot chassis, creating a practical robot that supports hands-on programming, electronics, and problem-solving activities. The kit is suitable for learning robotics through real movement, sensor interaction, and circuit-building experiments.

This robot kit is programmable with Python using Mu software or an online MicroPython editor. The cyber:bot board connects the micro:bit to the onboard Propeller Multicore Microcontroller, which helps manage real-time servo motor control and sensor circuits. This makes the robot more capable than using a micro:bit alone, especially for classroom robotics projects and interactive coding lessons.

The Cyber:bot Robot Kit – with Micro:Bit is ideal for robotics education, cybersecurity activities, Python programming, and electronics practice. Students can build circuits on the breadboard and explore sensors that respond to touch, visible light, and infrared light. It also supports expansion with compatible Parallax robot add-ons, making it a flexible platform for beginner and intermediate robotics learning.
The cyber: bot robot is a joint project of Parallax Inc. and CYBER.ORG, the academic initiative of the Cyber Innovation Center.

name: Converter Module 220V to 5KV – Mosquito Zapper Circuit
desc: The Converter Module 220V to 5KV steps up 220V AC to high voltage DC, ideal for mosquito zappers and insect control devices.

blocks.text: The Converter Module 220V to 5KV, often referred to as a “mosquito zapper circuit,” is a compact and high-voltage power module designed to convert standard household AC mains (220V) into a powerful high-voltage DC output, typically in the range of 3,000 to 5,000 volts. Despite its small size, this module plays a critical role in applications that require a sudden burst of high voltage at low current, such as insect-killing devices and high-voltage demonstration tools.

The core purpose of this module is to step up the voltage through a process involving switching transistors and a flyback transformer. The AC input is first rectified and filtered to DC, and then rapidly switched through a coil, inducing a high-voltage spike on the secondary winding. The output voltage is high enough to ionize air and generate a visible electric arc when two terminals are placed close together. This makes it ideal for electric mosquito swatters, bug zappers, and other pest control solutions that incapacitate insects using a sudden jolt of electricity.

The module is generally lightweight and built using durable materials to resist high-voltage wear. It is typically designed for intermittent operation, as continuous use may cause overheating or damage. For DIY hobbyists and electronics enthusiasts, it serves as an exciting component in high-voltage experiments, spark gap generators, or ignition modules.

Due to its ability to generate dangerous voltage levels, safety precautions must be observed while handling or integrating the module. Proper insulation, protective casing, and supervised use are essential to prevent electrical hazards.

In summary, the 220V to 5KV converter module is a powerful, compact, and efficient high-voltage source. Its primary use in mosquito zappers highlights its effectiveness in delivering fast, lethal electrical discharges with minimal power consumption, making it a valuable tool in both consumer devices and educational projects.
High Voltage Generation: Converts 220V AC to 3000V–5000V DC for effective insect control.
Compact and Lightweight: Small form factor makes it easy to integrate into various devices like mosquito zappers.
Efficient Voltage Conversion: Utilizes a flyback transformer and switching transistors for efficient voltage step-up.
Quick Burst of Power: Designed for intermittent operation, delivering rapid bursts of high voltage to eliminate insects.
Pest Control Application: Ideal for mosquito zappers, killing insects on contact with a powerful electrical shock.
Low Current Draw: Provides high voltage output with minimal current, making it energy-efficient.
Durable Construction: Built with durable materials that withstand high-voltage stress, ensuring long-term reliability.
